Page Industries reported a 4% increase in net profit to Rs 202.54 crore for Q2FY27, declared a second interim dividend of Rs 150 per share, and saw its shares trade 9% lower at Rs 33,570 on the NSE. Godrej Industries announced that Temasek Holdings affiliate Jongsong Investments Pte Ltd will invest ₹2,500 crore in Godrej Capital, valuing the firm at up to ₹28,000 crore while Godrej Industries retains about 80% ownership. Bank of Baroda raised interest rates by 10 basis points on its 555-day retail term deposit product, the ‘bob Golden Goal Deposit Scheme’, effective November 12, 2026. Indian benchmark equity indices Sensex and Nifty rose for the third straight day on Thursday driven by foreign institutional investor inflows and lower crude oil prices. The 50-share NSE Nifty rose 44.30 points, or 0.18 per cent, to close at 25,299.35. Bajaj Finance, State Bank of India, Bharat Electronics, Bajaj Finserv, ICICI Bank and Eternal gained among Sensex firms. Hindustan Unilever, Maruti, Power Grid and Tata Consultancy Services were among the laggards on the BSE Sensex. Liquefied natural gas is currently trading at a price above $30 per MMBtu for the Northern Hemisphere winter 2026/27. Europe is entering the winter season with its lowest gas storage levels of the 2020s. Northeast Asia is facing expensive liquefied natural gas and improved nuclear availability which are curbing gas demand and boosting coal burn. Henry Hub natural gas prices in the United States are expected to peak around $4 per MMBtu while being insulated from the global rally.

stories.headline: Oil prices fall over $1 as Middle East, Russia-Ukraine peace hopes grow; Brent slips below $92
stories.text: Brent futures fell by $1.14 to $91.62 a barrel by 0141 GMT on Thursday. US West Texas Intermediate crude futures dropped $1.04 to $85.49 on Thursday. Nissan Securities Investment chief strategist Hiroyuki Kikukawa attributed falling markets to ceasefire expectations. Russian and Ukrainian negotiators agreed to a major prisoner exchange during peace talks in Abu Dhabi. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy stated that Kyiv aimed to achieve concrete results resolving the war this year. Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei stated that Iran will not allow enriched nuclear material to leave the country. OPEC+ crude oil production increased in October driven by Saudi Arabia's output growth. US crude stocks increased by 9 million barrels in the latest week according to American Petroleum Institute data. Brent futures fell $1.14 or 1.2% to $91.62 a barrel by 0141 GMT on Thursday. US West Texas Intermediate crude futures dropped $1.04 or 1.2% to $85.49 on Thursday. Commodity markets traded lower on November 12, driven by peace talk hopes and hawkish Federal Reserve signals. Brent futures lost $1.14, or 1.2%, to $91.62 a barrel on Thursday. The dollar index rose 0.63% to 102.85, reaching its highest level since October 14.

stories.headline: Rupee falls 33 paise to close at 94.04 against US dollar
stories.text: The rupee depreciated 33 paise to close at 94.04 against the US dollar on Thursday according to provisional data. Mirae Asset Sharekhan Research Analyst Anuj Choudhary stated that the rupee is expected to trade with a slight negative bias. The dollar index was higher by 0.12 per cent at 103.03. Brent crude futures traded 0.55 per cent lower at $92.25 per barrel. Sensex advanced 31.61 points to settle at 81,911.01 on the domestic equity market. Nifty rose 44.30 points to close at 25,299.35. Foreign institutional investors purchased equities worth ₹12,563.33 crore on Wednesday based on exchange data. The Indian rupee appreciated by 7 paise to close provisionally at 93.70 against the US dollar on Wednesday. Mirae Asset Sharekhan Research Analyst Anuj Choudhary stated that the USDINR spot price is projected to trade between 93.40 and 93.95. The dollar index rose by 0.27 per cent to stand at 102.50. Brent crude futures traded 1.01 per cent higher at $92.41 per barrel. Foreign institutional investors bought equities worth ₹7,212.22 crore on Monday. Foreign investors invested Rs 53,739 crore into Indian equities during the first nine days of November. CR Forex Advisors MD Amit Pabari stated that the rupee's underlying momentum remains positive due to foreign capital return, softer crude prices, and improving geopolitical sentiment. In the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at around 93.71 on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. The dollar index traded at 102.26, higher by 0.03%, measuring the greenback against a basket of six currencies. Foreign institutional investors purchased equities worth ₹7,212.22 crore on Monday, November 9, 2026.

stories.headline: India October CPI Inflation Rises to 6.09% YoY
stories.text: India headline Consumer Price Index inflation reached 6.09% year-on-year for October 2026. The October inflation print exceeded market consensus estimates of 5.93% and a prior reading of 5.54%. Rural inflation stood at 6.63% for October 2026. Ola Electric reported second quarter revenue of ₹421 Crore compared to ₹690 Crore year-on-year. Oil India declared an interim dividend of ₹7 per share for shareholders. Fiem Industries reported second quarter revenue of ₹9.37 Billion versus ₹7.15 Billion year-on-year. India's retail inflation based on the Consumer Price Index rose to a two-year high of 6.09% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit of 6%. Consumer Food Price Index inflation accelerated to 8.94% in October compared to 7.74% in September, driven by rural food inflation of 9.09% and urban food inflation of 8.68%. The Reserve Bank of India targets inflation at 4% with a tolerance band of 2% to 6%, and the October data is the final retail inflation release before its December 4 policy decision. Sujan Hajra from Anand Rathi group stated that relief could come from Brent crude easing to around US$92/bbl, ample foodgrain stocks, and government interventions, while weak monsoon and El Niño risks prolong pressures. ICRA expects year-on-year inflation in the food and beverages segment to remain elevated above 8.0% in November 2026 due to pressure from milk, sugar, and onion prices. Aditi Nayar, Chief Economist at ICRA, stated that core inflation is expected to inch up in November 2026 due to an unfavourable base effect from GST rationalisation, keeping headline CPI inflation at ~6.1%. India's Consumer Price Index rose to 6.09% year-on-year in October according to provisional data. India's rural prices increased by 6.63% year-on-year in October compared to 5.41% in urban areas. The Consumer Food Price Index in India rose 8.94% year-on-year in October. Rural food inflation reached 9.09% and urban food inflation stood at 8.68% in October. The market is pricing in a 31% probability of a larger 50 bps move at the next Reserve Bank of India meeting.

stories.headline: India's Copper Supply Security Gets A Push As Adani Group Signs Exploration Agreement With Chile's State-Owned Mining Giant Codelco
stories.text: Adani Group's Kutch Copper Ltd signed a memorandum of understanding with Chile's Codelco on November 12, 2026. The memorandum of understanding targets the exploration of the Kaburkaala copper project in northern Chile. The agreement was signed during London Metal Exchange Week 2026 in London. The project is located in the Calama copper belt of the Antofagasta region. The partnership connects copper resources in Chile with Adani's integrated copper smelter complex at Mundra in Gujarat. Adani will provide capital, technology-led exploration and large-scale project execution capabilities. Codelco will contribute geological expertise and international experience to the partnership. The collaboration follows an earlier memorandum of understanding signed in 2025. The International Energy Agency reported that India avoided over USD 100 billion, or Rs 9.4 lakh crore, in coal and natural gas import costs from 2011 to 2025 due to renewable energy expansion. The International Energy Agency projects that India's cumulative savings on coal and gas imports could reach nearly USD 240 billion, or Rs 22.6 lakh crore, by 2030. The International Energy Agency estimated that annual savings from renewable energy in India could reach around USD 35 billion, or Rs 3.3 lakh crore, by 2030. India's renewable energy capacity nearly quadrupled over the past decade, crossing 300 GW in 2026. Between March 2014 and September 2026, India added 168 GW of solar capacity, 38 GW of wind capacity, and reached nearly 12 GW of bioenergy capacity. India has saved more than USD 100 billion, equivalent to Rs 9.4 lakh crore, on coal and natural gas imports from 2011 to 2025 using renewable energy, as stated by the International Energy Agency. Without added solar, wind, and bioenergy capacity since 2010, India would have needed around 110 million tonnes of additional imported coal in 2025, according to the International Energy Agency.

stories.headline: India New Zealand football match today LIVE streaming info: When, where to watch IND v NZ match?
stories.text: The Indian men’s football team will play an international friendly against New Zealand on Thursday at the Go Media Stadium in Auckland. The match is the first of two friendlies scheduled between the two teams to mark 100 years of sporting connection between the nations. Khalid Jamil selected a changed squad for the friendlies compared to the previous window when India played Panama, Brazil, and Uruguay. Gurpreet Singh Sandhu was dropped as captain and senior goalkeeper, while Som Kumar, Ricky Meetei Haobam, Lalremtluanga Fanai, and Tomba Singh Haobam received call ups. Bijoy Varghese, Muhammad Suhail, and Liston Colaco left the ongoing SAFF championship to join the senior squad. India is ranked 138th in the world rankings while New Zealand is ranked 88th. The match will not be televised anywhere in India and will be livestreamed on FIFA+ via DAZN. The Indian men's football team will play two international friendly matches against New Zealand on November 12 and 15, 2026. The first match will take place at Go Media Stadium in Auckland, and the second match will be held at One New Zealand Stadium in Christchurch. India head coach Khalid Jamil selected a 23-member squad for the tour, featuring players like Ryan Williams, Manvir Singh, Liston Colaco, and Anirudh Thapa. New Zealand announced a 22-member squad led by striker Chris Wood, who plays for Nottingham Forest. Live streaming for the matches in India will be available exclusively on FIFA+ via DAZN, with no television broadcast. India and New Zealand have faced each other twice previously, with a goalless draw in 1981 and a 2-1 defeat for India in the 2018 Intercontinental Cup. India's drone industry faces risks due to heavy reliance on imported components like motors and batteries, according to the Drone Federation India. China is set to widen export controls to autopilots, radios, motors and speed controllers from November 18, following prior restrictions on components and rare earth magnets. The Drone Federation India is expected to release a policy paper titled Making the Swadeshi Switch with 22 recommendations at the Bharat Drone Stack Conference 2026 opening in Bengaluru on November 12. China accounts for approximately 94% of global permanent magnet production, as stated by Smit Shah, president of the Drone Federation India. The domestic drone component market alone is targeted at $3.08 billion, according to estimates by the Drone Federation India.

stories.headline: Money Market Operations as on November 10, 2026
stories.text: Reserve Bank of India Marginal Standing Facility operations on November 10, 2026, totaled an amount of ₹7,331.00 crore at a current rate of 5.75 per cent. Reserve Bank of India Standing Deposit Facility operations on November 10, 2026, amounted to ₹2,07,233.00 crore at a rate of 5.25 per cent. Net liquidity absorbed from today's Reserve Bank of India operations on November 10, 2026, was ₹-1,99,902.00 crore. Outstanding variable rate repo operations conducted by the Reserve Bank of India on November 09, 2026, stood at ₹50,003.00 crore with a cut-off rate of 5.51 per cent. Standing Liquidity Facility availed from the Reserve Bank of India was ₹10,306.87 crore. Marginal Standing Facility operations conducted on November 11, 2026, amounted to 201.00 crore rupees at a rate of 5.75 per cent maturing on November 12, 2026. Standing Deposit Facility operations on November 11, 2026, absorbed 1,94,258.00 crore rupees at a rate of 5.25 per cent.

stories.headline: Global OPEC+ oil exports close to prewar levels amid ongoing incidents in Strait of Hormuz
stories.text: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and its allies crude oil production rose sharply in October to an average of 41.23 million barrels per day. Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and its allies production increased by 2.04 million barrels per day from September according to the monthly report released Wednesday. Saudi Arabia reported production of 10.563 million barrels per day in October, an increase from 8.372 million barrels per day in September. OPEC secondary sources estimated Saudi Arabia production at 9.194 million barrels per day in October. Iraq recorded a production recovery with output rising from 3.995 million barrels per day in September to 4.491 million barrels per day in October according to OPEC secondary sources. Iraqi Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair stated in October that Iraq oil exports had exceeded 3.4 million barrels per day, approaching pre-war levels of approximately 3.7 million barrels per day. United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reported an incident involving a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, following a separate vessel strike off Oman. Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries noted that freight rates for very large crude carriers surged in October to more than ten times levels from a year earlier. Saudi Arabia pumped 10.563 million barrels per day of crude in October, increasing from September output. The OPEC+ group pumped 41.23 million bpd in October, rising by about 2.04 million bpd from September. Russia's energy output increased after US President Donald Trump lifted sanctions on Russian energy and announced an energy ceasefire in mid-October. Umud Shokri stated that higher Saudi oil production could help ease inflationary pressure facing American consumers. US annual personal consumption expenditures shot to a three-year high of 4.1 percent in May as energy prices soared.

stories.headline: Gold Declines to $3,973 as US Inflation Raises Expectations of December Fed Rate Increase
stories.text: Gold prices dropped below $4,000 per ounce on Thursday, November 12, 2026, due to higher-than-expected US inflation and Federal Reserve commentary. Spot gold declined 0.4% to $3,973.13 per ounce at 00:16 ET (05:16 GMT), and US gold futures fell 0.6% to $3,978.57. The US Dollar Index increased 0.1% to 102.98, putting further pressure on precious metals. Investors priced in a 25-basis-point interest rate increase at the Federal Reserve meeting in December, with some considering a 50-basis-point adjustment. Chicago Federal Reserve President Austan Goolsbee called the October inflation report borderline disturbing, and policymaker Anna Paulson noted persistent price pressures. Two-year US Treasury yields rose by 18 basis points on Tuesday as markets reacted to potential tighter monetary policy. ANZ analysts stated that the latest inflation figures and continued economic activity raised expectations for a more restrictive Federal Reserve policy stance. Spot gold dropped by 0.4% to $3,973.13 per ounce at 00:16 ET on Thursday, November 12, 2026. United States gold futures declined by 0.6% to $3,978.57 at 00:16 ET on Thursday, November 12, 2026. Silver decreased by 0.6% to $51.3605 per ounce on Thursday, November 12, 2026. The United States Dollar Index advanced by 0.1% to reach 102.98 on Thursday, November 12, 2026.

stories.headline: OceanaGold Philippines eyes automation push at gold-copper mine
stories.text: OceanaGold Philippines plans to introduce further automated mining systems at the Didipio mine in Nueva Vizcaya, Philippines, in 2027. Asset President James Isles stated that each underground loader costs about US$2 million, with an automation package cost of US$200,000–300,000. OceanaGold Philippines scheduled the introduction of an automated production drill, a ventilation-on-demand system, and an upgraded loader automation system for 2027. OceanaGold Philippines plans to resume exploration drilling at one target within its 5,000-hectare agreement package in 2027. As of 31 December 2025, the Didipio mine hosted 45.2 million tonnes of measured and indicated mineral resources. The mineral inventory at the Didipio mine contains 1.34 million ounces of gold, 2.4 million ounces of silver, and 0.16 million tonnes of copper. OceanaGold Philippines received three recognitions at the Towards Sustainable Mining Excellence Awards 2026, including two Gold Protocol Awards. President John Dramani Mahama directed the Petroleum Commission and other state agencies to collaborate with the Petroleum Hub Development Corporation on feedstock supply mechanisms. President John Dramani Mahama spoke at the opening of the 15th Local Content Conference and Exhibition in Takoradi on 10 November 2026. The consortium partnering on Lot Two comprises participants from South Korea, the United Arab Emirates and Mali. Lot Two infrastructure will include a refinery with a capacity of 300,000 barrels per stream day and two petrochemical plants. Lot Two storage infrastructure will feature a capacity of four million cubic metres along with a multi-berth jetty. Petroleum Hub Development Corporation Chief Executive Officer Dr Toni Aubynn stated the facilities are expected to be developed within five years. Initial construction-related activities at the Jomoro project site are scheduled to begin in the first quarter of 2027.

stories.headline: Gold falls to over one-week low on firm dollar, Fed rate hike bets
stories.text: Spot gold declined by 0.2% to $3,981.49 per ounce by 0310 GMT on Thursday, hitting its lowest level since November 4. US gold futures for December delivery decreased by 0.3% to $3,987.50. The dollar strengthened to a 19-month high against major peers on Thursday, increasing bullion's cost for holders of other currencies. The probability of a half-percentage-point Federal Reserve rate hike next month increased after October US inflation data exceeded expectations on Tuesday. Market participants are awaiting the US Producer Price Index report scheduled for release on Friday. OCBC analysts noted they do not hold a bearish outlook on gold's medium-term prospects despite a less favorable macro backdrop. Spot palladium rose by 1% to reach $1,037.25 per ounce. Spot gold prices dropped 0.2% to $3,977.99 per ounce by 0506 GMT on Thursday, hitting a level not seen since November 4. US gold futures contracts for December delivery declined by 0.4% to $3,983.20. Spot palladium prices increased by 0.5% to $1,032.63 per ounce on Thursday. Ilya Spivak, who serves as the head of global macro at Tastylive, stated that the gold market has experienced a meaningful pullback following US inflation data. Analysts at OCBC noted that oil prices, yields, and the US dollar remain important drivers, and they are not turning bearish on medium-term prospects.

stories.headline: Brent oil rebounds after attacks on ships in Hormuz
stories.text: Brent oil prices increased after reports of a vessel attack near the Strait of Hormuz. The UK Maritime and Commercial Operations reported an oil tanker was struck by an unknown projectile northeast of Lima in Oman. The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Navy stated that two oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Mohsen Rezaei, head of Iran's National Security Council, rejected United States statements regarding ongoing negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The American Petroleum Institute reported a 9 million barrel rise in United States crude oil inventories for the week ending November 6. The benchmark ICE Brent contract for the nearest month rose by $0.96 per barrel to reach $91.55 at 09:00 GMT on Wednesday according to Engine Online. Russian and Ukrainian officials conducted peace talks in Abu Dhabi mediated by the United States. Brent crude futures rose 1.17% to $92.56 per barrel and US West Texas Intermediate crude surged 0.79% above $86.72 per barrel on the morning of Wednesday, November 11. Brent crude futures slid to a two-month low of $89.16 per barrel on Tuesday after US President Donald Trump signaled that the West Asia war may be ending. Crude stocks rose by 9 million barrels in the week ended November 6, according to data from the American Petroleum Institute. Goldman Sachs increased its December Brent crude forecast to $105 a barrel and bumped its West Texas Intermediate crude outlook to $94 a barrel.

stories.headline: Gold Price Recovers Above US$4,000 As Analysts Forecast Further Gains
stories.text: Gold prices recovered on 11 November after dropping about 3% in the previous session, holding above the US$4,000 per ounce level. Spot gold traded near US$4,040 per ounce, having faced earlier selling pressure from stronger-than-expected US inflation data and Federal Reserve tightening expectations. Standard Chartered forecasts an average gold price of US$4,650 per ounce in the fourth quarter of 2026 and US$4,850 in the first quarter of 2027. Gold-backed exchange-traded products recorded 211 tonnes of investment demand in the third quarter of 2026, alongside another 19 tonnes in October. Central bank purchases reached 321 tonnes in the third quarter, exceeding Standard Chartered's estimate of 200 tonnes as reserves were diversified. CPM Group views the recent price decline as a consolidation period after several days of gains rather than the end of the broader upward trend. A Reuters poll of 30 metals analysts forecasts that silver will average $66 per troy ounce in 2027. The World Bank expects silver to average $62 in 2027, driven by a rebalancing of supply and demand. Fresnillo reported an 11.6 per cent year-on-year fall in third-quarter silver output to 10.3 million ounces. India's Commerce Ministry data shows that silver imports in September fell by 49.11 per cent year-on-year. The Federal Reserve held interest rates at 3.75 to 4 per cent in October after raising rates in September.

stories.headline: UK inflation to overshoot Bank of England target for next 4 years, think-tank forecasts
stories.text: The National Institute of Economic and Social Research stated on Tuesday (Nov 10) that inflation in the United Kingdom will not return to the Bank of England target before 2030. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research forecast that United Kingdom inflation will peak at 4.4 per cent in February 2027. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research expects the United Kingdom economy to grow 1.6 per cent in 2026. The jobless rate in the United Kingdom is projected by the National Institute of Economic and Social Research to gradually rise from 4.8 per cent in 2026. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research stated that finance minister John Healey’s October budget did little to strengthen the public finances. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research expects the Bank of England to raise interest rates only once, in February. The Bank of England raised interest rates to 4 per cent from 3.75 per cent last week. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research warned that inflation will remain above the target until the end of 2030 because policymakers were too slow to raise interest rates. The Bank raised interest rates last week from 3.75pc to 4pc, marking the first increase since August 2023. Andrew Bailey warned that further rate rises could occur as the war in Iran pushes up prices for households and businesses. Clare Lombardelli stated on Tuesday that back-to-back interest rate rises were a possibility depending on incoming data. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research stated that inflation would peak at 4.4pc in February. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research predicted that economic growth will fall from 1.6pc this year to 1.1pc in 2027.

stories.headline: Aditya Birla Capital opens 100th Gold Loan branch, enters Mumbai market
stories.text: Aditya Birla Capital Limited inaugurated its 100th dedicated Gold Loan branch at Santacruz, Mumbai, on November 12, 2026. Aditya Birla Capital Limited reported an AUM of ₹200 crore for its Gold Loan business as of September 30, 2026. In Q2 FY27, Aditya Birla Capital Limited's NBFC AUM grew 26 per cent year-on-year to ₹1,76,557 crore. In Q2 FY27, Aditya Birla Capital Limited's NBFC profit before tax climbed 41 per cent to ₹1,352 crore. Aditya Birla Capital opened its 100th gold loan branch within three months of entering the segment. Aditya Birla Capital is expanding its gold loan business using a branch-led model. Aditya Birla Capital targets having more than 1,000 gold loan branches over the next three years.

stories.headline: Crude Falls 1% as Iran, Ukraine Talks Ease Supply Fears
stories.text: Crude oil prices declined more than 1% on Thursday, November 12, due to diplomatic progress in the Iran and Russia-Ukraine wars. Brent crude futures fell 1.2% to $91.7 per barrel on Thursday, November 12. US West Texas Intermediate crude futures dropped 1.1% to $85.6 on Thursday, November 12. Russian and Ukrainian negotiators agreed to a major prisoner exchange after two days of US-mediated discussions in Abu Dhabi. U.S. West Texas Intermediate fell $1.04, or 1.2%, to $85.49 on Thursday. Washington Institute for Near East Policy data showed 37 ships were attacked in October, which is the highest monthly tally since the war began in February. OPEC+ crude production increased in October, with a sharp rise from Saudi Arabia, and Kpler data showed Middle East crude and condensate outages dropped to about 3.8 million barrels per day. Since the start of November, Brent has fallen about 21% and West Texas Intermediate has dropped about 17%.

stories.headline: US envoys arrive in Moscow for Ukraine talks with Vladimir Putin
stories.text: US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff arrived in Moscow to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin following talks in Abu Dhabi. Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff were scheduled to meet Vladimir Putin at 12:00 local time before traveling to Dublin to speak with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. Jared Kushner stated on Tuesday that the United States observed opportunities to make progress during the upcoming meeting with Vladimir Putin. Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff planned to ask Vladimir Putin to approve the inclusion of European representatives in future discussions regarding European security architecture. Russian delegation head Vladimir Medinsky stated that all parties moved closer to peace following the talks in Abu Dhabi. Volodymyr Zelensky reported that the Ukrainian military faced systematic restrictions regarding Elon Musk's SpaceX Starshield satellite internet service. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine is investigating fresh restrictions on SpaceX's Starshield service over the country. Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported significant disruptions to Starshield's operations along the entire front line and temporarily occupied territories for several days. Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the restrictions imposed an effective speed limit on terminals moving above 161 kilometers per hour, disconnecting faster-moving equipment. Serhii Beskrestnov confirmed on Thursday that the speed of Starlink operation during movement was again limited.

stories.headline: Moneycontrol Pro Panorama | Will India’s renewable energy boom create global champions?
stories.text: India saved over $100 billion in fuel imports from 2011 to 2025 through renewable electricity, according to the International Energy Agency. India has surpassed the United States to become the second-largest growth market for renewables globally, trailing only China. Solar module manufacturing capacities in India grew roughly 10 times in under five years between 2022 and 2026. The Indian Solar Manufacturers Association stated that India is expected to manufacture every stage of solar modules by the middle of the next decade. Analysts estimate that EBITDA at Premier Energies will double over FY25-FY27. Waaree Energies is guiding for an EBITDA of Rs 7,000–7,700 crore for FY27, compared to Rs 5,908 crore in FY26. India's 2026 southwest monsoon concluded roughly 13% below normal, diminishing soil moisture during the kharif season and limiting maize yield potential. Industry estimates indicate India's total corn production could decrease from roughly 25 million tonnes to about 23.5 million tonnes in 2026/27. India's corn contribution to ethanol feedstocks increased from practically zero in 2021/22 to roughly 37% in 2025/26 due to policy-driven capacity expansion. Compound Livestock Feed Manufacturers Association of India requested temporary relaxations on corn imports, curbs on scarce feed ingredient exports, and measures to stabilize feed costs.

stories.headline: German startup SE3 raises $30 million for AI for military drones — Fortune
stories.text: Munich-based startup SE3 raised $30 million in a Series A funding round led by venture firm Accel. The startup raised €5.5 million, or $6.1 million, in seed investment less than five months prior. SE3 develops artificial intelligence software that combines video and sensor data from drones and ground vehicles into a battlefield picture. SE3 co-founder and CEO Lukas Kestler stated that military officers can assign reconnaissance tasks via natural-language commands. SE3 has contracts with the Bundeswehr and has demonstrated its high-level control system to the German military. SE3 plans to expand its staff from about 40 to 120 employees and open several new offices. Accel partner Matt Robinson stated that SE3's team is uniquely qualified to build spatial AI for autonomous systems. SE3 plans to expand its employee headcount from roughly 40 to about 120 staff members. SE3 intends to establish new offices in London, Berlin, the Nordics and Baltics, and Poland.

stories.headline: Conversion/Switch of Government of India Securities
stories.text: The Government of India announced a conversion or switch of its securities through an auction totaling an aggregate face value amount of Rs 25,000 crore. Market participants are required to submit their bids electronically on the Reserve Bank of India Core Banking Solution e-Kuber platform. Bidding for the conversion auction is scheduled to take place on November 16, 2026, between 10:30 AM and 11:30 AM. The auction results will be announced on November 16, 2026, and the settlement will occur on November 17, 2026. The minimum bid size for the auction is set at Rs 10,000 and can be in multiples of Rs 10,000 thereafter. The quoted price of the source security must equal the FBIL closing price of the source security from the previous working day.

stories.headline: From blood group ID to cycle racks: I asked for little ways to fix broken Britain and the public’s ideas give me hope | Martin Lewis
stories.text: Martin Lewis launched the Small Ideas Initiative a month ago to collect practical and low-cost suggestions for improving the United Kingdom. The Small Ideas Initiative has received 42,000 suggestions from the public since its launch. Martin Lewis funded the Small Ideas Initiative, while charities Nesta and Involve are running the project in the background. Nesta and Involve will filter and publish at least 1,000 of the best suggestions and turn 200 of them into fully researched policy proposals. A cross-party panel ranging from Green to Reform will unanimously agree on the final 50-ish proposals to form a Small Ideas manifesto. The deadline to submit solutions at Small-Ideas.org is 5pm on Thursday 12 November. On November 12, China's computing-power hardware supply chain rallied in early A-share trade, driven by an overnight triple boost for the artificial intelligence sector in the United States. During the overnight United States session, CoreWeave reported results that beat market expectations, artificial intelligence startup Anthropic had an oversubscribed initial public offering, and OpenAI's quarterly revenue exceeded $10 billion for the first time. The STAR 50 Index surged over 4% intraday at one point on November 12, while Cambricon shares climbed back above the 1,000-yuan level after rising more than 11% intraday. Combined Shanghai-Shenzhen turnover for the half-day session reached 1.22 trillion yuan on November 12, marking an increase of 293.1 billion yuan or approximately $44.0 billion from the previous trading day. In contrast to mainland markets, Hong Kong stocks opened lower on November 12, with both the Hang Seng Index and the Hang Seng Tech Index dropping by more than 1% in early trade.

stories.headline: Underwriting Auction for sale of Government Security for ₹34,000 crore on November 13, 2026
stories.text: The Government of India announced the sale of a Government Security through auction for an amount of ₹34,000 crore on November 13, 2026. The security being auctioned is the 6.94% GS 2036 with a notified amount of ₹34,000 crore. The Minimum Underwriting Commitment amount per Primary Dealer is set at ₹810 crore. The minimum bidding commitment per Primary Dealer under the Additional Competitive Underwriting auction is ₹810 crore. The underwriting auction will be conducted utilizing a multiple price-based method on November 13, 2026.

stories.headline: Live: Broader markets outperform in a quiet market; Oil at $93/barrel | Closing Bell
stories.text: Bank Nifty extended its winning streak to a third consecutive session on the Sensex weekly expiry day. The IT index recorded a decline for the fourth straight day during the session. Midcap and smallcap indices continued their upward movement for a fourth consecutive session. Nvidia declined by about 13% over the five-day period, with reports indicating a potential CEO replacement. Nasdaq futures dropped by over 250 points, while S&P 500 futures edged lower and Dow futures traded slightly positive. Asian markets experienced weak trade, with the Nikkei and Kospi dropping 0.6-0.7%. Brent crude strengthened and traded near $93 per barrel. HDFC Life, Shriram Finance, and Bajaj Finance led the Nifty50 gainers, whereas ONGC, HUL, M&M, and Nestle India lagged.

stories.headline: Caledonia Mining says gold production back to normal, higher gold prices supported financials in Q3
stories.text: Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC stated that gold production at the Blanket mine in Zimbabwe returned to normal following a disrupted third quarter. Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC reported that a profit after tax declined 39% to US$11.3 million due to a US$12.9 million non-cash loss on derivatives. Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC received an average of US$4,134 an ounce for gold in the three months to September, compared to US$3,434 a year earlier. Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC revenue increased 10.5% to US$78.9 million while gross profit rose 13.6% to US$41.9 million. Blanket produced 17,030 ounces of gold, marking an 11% year-on-year decrease due to a compressed-air shortage and about 1,100 ounces remaining trapped in the processing plant. Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC brought new compressors into service on 31 October and recovered more than half of the trapped gold using a new vessel at the plant. Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC revised its guidance for the Blanket mine to produce 69,000–72,500 ounces in 2026. Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC targeted first gold at the Bilboes project for the fourth quarter of 2028.

stories.headline: Stock markets climb in early trade led by foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices
stories.text: Indian benchmark equity indices Sensex and Nifty climbed in early trade on Thursday, November 12, 2026. The 30-share BSE Sensex advanced 166.44 points to reach 82,013.58 in early trade. The 50-share NSE Nifty increased by 55.65 points to trade at 25,316.55. Foreign Institutional Investors purchased equities worth ₹12,563.33 crore on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Brent crude traded 1.12 percent lower at $91.75 per barrel. V.K. Vijayakumar from Geojit Investments Ltd stated that Foreign Institutional Investors invested ₹65,735 crore in Indian equities in November. On Wednesday, November 11, 2026, the BSE Sensex closed 772.75 points higher at 81,879.40. On Wednesday, November 11, 2026, the NSE Nifty closed 210.40 points higher at 25,255.05.

stories.headline: Crude oil price slips on US-Iran peace talk hopes; Brent dips below $92, WTI under $86
stories.text: Crude oil prices declined on Thursday, November 12, following investor optimism about potential peace talks to resolve conflicts in the Middle East and between Russia and Ukraine. At approximately 9.20 am on Thursday, November 12, Brent crude futures decreased by 1.11 percent to $91.72 per barrel. At around 9.20 am on Thursday, November 12, US West Texas Intermediate crude futures dropped by 0.97 percent to $85.71 a barrel. Negotiators representing Russia and Ukraine agreed on a major prisoner exchange during two days of peace talks held in Abu Dhabi. According to market sources citing American Petroleum Institute data, US crude inventories increased by 9 million barrels over the past week. JPMorgan analysts reported that global supply exceeded consumption, estimating a surplus of 1.1 million barrels per day in September and 1.4 million bpd in October. Goldman Sachs raised its Brent crude price forecast to $105 a barrel by December, up from its previous $90 forecast. Goldman Sachs revised its price projection for US West Texas Intermediate crude upwards to $94 a barrel from $81.

stories.headline: Altius to buy TNR Gold in $86-million royalty deal
stories.text: Altius Minerals agreed to purchase TNR Gold in a transaction valued at C$122 million, or $86 million. Eligible TNR Gold shareholders will receive 0.0072 Altius Minerals shares and a quarter-share in a new company for the Shotgun gold project. The transaction represents a 60% premium compared to TNR Gold closing at 30¢ on Tuesday. Altius Minerals previously invested $4.2 million for a minority stake in May and owned about 13% of TNR Gold by October. McEwen Copper targets a final investment decision and full project financing for Los Azules by mid-2027, with commercial production beginning in 2030. Ganfeng Lithium inaugurated a 20,000-tonne-per-year lithium chloride plant at the Mariana project in February 2025. Closing of the TNR Gold acquisition is anticipated around the first quarter of 2027, contingent on regulatory, court, and shareholder approvals. TNR Gold shares closed at 30¢ in Toronto on Tuesday, while Altius Minerals shares dropped 3.5% to $51.14 on Wednesday.

stories.headline: Gold falls below $4,000, silver slips too: What's weighing on precious metal prices?
stories.text: On November 12, gold and silver prices declined due to strong US inflation data, a firm dollar, and hawkish signals from the Federal Reserve. On the Multi Commodity Exchange, December gold futures declined 0.41% to ₹1,39,140 per 10 grams on November 12. On the Multi Commodity Exchange, December silver futures fell 0.83% to ₹1,83,001 per kg on November 12. In October, US consumer prices rose 0.4% month-on-month compared to market expectations of 0.3%. Crude oil prices have fallen nearly 18% in November, failing to provide support to precious metals. Sugandha Sachdeva of SS WealthStreet stated that the near-term outlook for gold and silver remains cautious to negative. Markets will track the US Producer Price Index data and weekly jobless claims scheduled for release on November 13.

stories.headline: Crude oil is caught between hopes of de-escalation and concerns of further escalation. What's next?
stories.text: Crude oil prices consolidated around recent lows as traders monitored US-Iran uncertainty. Oil prices dipped following a Wall Street Journal report that US Vice President Vance considered face-to-face talks with a top Iranian security official. Iranian officials accused Washington of preparing further military strikes or tighter economic pressure. The US military stated its blockade prevented Iran from exporting oil while working to keep the Strait of Hormuz open to commercial shipping. Crude oil contracts consolidated around the key 87.00 handle on the daily chart. Sellers targeted the 80.00 handle next while buyers eyed a rally into the 110.00 resistance with 92.50 as the first target. US Jobless Claims figures were scheduled for release on the day of the report.

stories.headline: Can sharp fall in crude oil prices brighten the outlook for paint stocks? Here’s what charts say
stories.text: Crude oil prices dropped by over 20% in two weeks, causing a strong rally in paint stocks. Asian Paints shares surged 15% from the October 30 lows and crossed the 200 EMA level of ₹2,511 apiece. Berger Paints shares rallied 8% in the recent rally but failed to sustain above the 200 EMA level of ₹492 apiece. Indigo Paints shares surged 16% in eight trading days and trade below the 200 EMA of ₹1,034 apiece. Kansai Nerolac shares rallied over 17% in November on a month-to-date basis and crossed the 200 day EMA level of ₹202 apiece. JSW Dulux shares witnessed a strong rally of 16 from the November 4 lows while trading below the 200 EMA of ₹305 apiece. Asian Paints and Kansai Nerolac delivered 16.9% and 18.6% revenue growth respectively for the quarter ended September 2026.

stories.headline: Gold and silver prices declined globally, with the dollar rising to its highest level in 19 months
stories.text: Global gold and silver prices declined during Thursday's trading session. The U.S. dollar strengthened as investors bet on an upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate hike next month. The Dollar Index rose by 0.10% to trade at 103.00 points, having touched a 19-month high of 103.08 points. Gold futures for December delivery fell by $15.40 to settle at $3,985.10 per ounce. The spot price of gold dropped by $7.81 to reach $3,980.09 per ounce. Silver futures for December delivery declined by $0.46 to reach $51.54. Spot silver saw a decrease of $0.07, settling at $51.6140.

stories.headline: Infosys Science Foundation announces six winners of Infosys Prize 2026
stories.text: The Infosys Science Foundation announced six researchers as winners of the Infosys Prize 2026. Karthik Sastry won the Economics category for his work on climate change, technological innovation, and business cycles. Swarun Kumar won the Engineering and Computer Science category for advances in low-power wireless networks, sensing, and control. Gautam Bhatia won the Humanities and Social Sciences category for his contributions to legal scholarship. Isha Jain won the Life Sciences category for pioneering discoveries in oxygen biology and new therapeutic strategies. Riddhipratim Basu won the Mathematical Sciences category for contributions to probability theory and statistical physics. Manoj Kumar Joshi won the Physical Sciences category for experimental advances in quantum simulation using trapped ions.

stories.headline: Gold Prices Slide 1.54%; Jewellery Stocks Rally Strong
stories.text: Ten grams of 24-carat gold declined to Rs 1,39,800 on Thursday, falling Rs 2,180 or 1.54 per cent from Wednesday's Rs 1,41,980. The Nifty 50 traded at 25,345.40 around 10:36 am on Thursday, recording an increase of 90.35 points or 0.36 per cent compared to the previous close. Jewellery stocks moved higher in early trade on Thursday despite the decline in gold prices. Kalyan Jewellers India surged 6.77 per cent to trade at ₹708.70, rising ₹44.95 from its previous close of ₹663.75. PC Jeweller increased by 1.90 per cent, rising ₹0.30 to reach ₹16.08. Thangamayil Jewellery added 1.76 per cent, gaining ₹75.60 to trade at ₹4,376.60 from a previous close of ₹4,301.00. Titan Company advanced 1.05 per cent, moving up ₹52.00 to ₹5,022.00 compared to its Wednesday close of ₹4,970.00.

stories.headline: Crude oil futures fall amid reports of planned US-Iran talks
stories.text: Crude oil futures traded lower on Thursday morning following reports of planned US-Iran talks. At 10.02 am on Thursday, January Brent oil futures were valued at $91.29, declining by 1.58 per cent. December crude oil futures on West Texas Intermediate were recorded at $85.30, decreasing by 1.42 per cent. November crude oil futures on the Multi Commodity Exchange traded at ₹7995 during the initial hour of trading on Thursday, dropping by 2.31 per cent from the previous close of ₹8184. December futures on the Multi Commodity Exchange traded at ₹7937 on Thursday, falling by 2.17 per cent compared to the previous close of ₹8113. A Wall Street Journal report indicated that US Vice President JD Vance is considering face-to-face discussions with a top Iranian security official. November natural gas futures on the Multi Commodity Exchange traded at ₹308 during Thursday's initial hour of trading, rising by 0.69 per cent from the previous close of ₹305.90.

stories.headline: Crude oil from northern Iraq smuggled to Iran, Afghanistan
stories.text: An Iraqi intelligence investigation found that crude oil and petroleum products are smuggled from the Kirkuk and Sulaymaniyah fields into Iran. Smugglers use the Bashmaq and Parviz Khan border crossings to move the oil into Iran. Small and medium-sized tanker trucks transport the crude oil and derivatives to the Iranian border. Once inside Iran, the smuggled oil is processed and mixed with Iranian petroleum products at small refineries. The mixed gasoline is sold using false origin certificates to evade international restrictions, with Afghanistan as the primary destination. Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi established a multi-agency investigating group to confront the oil smuggling networks. Iraq’s Federal Commission of Integrity launched an investigation targeting the oil smuggling network.

stories.headline: Japan's October Corporate Goods Price Index Rises 7.1%, Pushed Up by Crude Oil Prices and AI Demand; About 90% of Items Post Gains
stories.text: The Bank of Japan announced on the 12th that Japan's October Corporate Goods Price Index rose 7.1% year-on-year to 136.8. The growth rate for the Corporate Goods Price Index expanded by 0.3 percentage points from 6.8% in September. About 90% of surveyed items, specifically 469 out of 515, recorded year-on-year price increases. In the category breakdown, Petroleum & Coal Products rose 15.9% and Chemical Products rose 15.5%. Non-Ferrous Metals saw a standout gain of 31.7% due to copper prices soaring on construction demand for AI data centers. Agriculture, Forestry & Fishery Products dropped sharply by 25.0% as rice prices fell when new rice began circulating. The Import Price Index rose 24.8% in yen terms, showing that yen weakness continues to push up import costs.

stories.headline: Nasdaq futures slide on Huang Ouster report | Crude oil prices rangebound
stories.text: Wall Street closed higher with the Dow rising 0.49%, the S&P 500 gaining 1.31%, and the Nasdaq increasing by 1.60%. CoreWeave shares surged 25% following strong third-quarter results and guidance. Nasdaq futures declined following reports that Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang. The Nifty closed at a fresh nine-month high above 25,200, while the Nifty Bank approached its record high. Brent crude oil prices remained steady around $92 a barrel amid geopolitical tensions involving the US, Iran, and Israel. Foreign Portfolio Investors extended their buying spree, with November net buying reaching $7.3 billion in just seven sessions. MSCI raised India's weight in its Emerging Markets index by adding Life Insurance Corporation, Adani Green, Meesho, and Coforge, effective November 30.

stories.headline: Gold prices fall below $4,000 as analysts warn of further losses toward $3,900
stories.text: Spot gold prices fell below the $4,000-an-ounce level and traded at $3,987 an ounce, which was down more than 1% on the day. Bark Melek, Head of Commodity Strategy at TD Securities, stated in a Tuesday report that gold prices are expected to retest support near $3,900 an ounce. Headline inflation rose by 0.4% in October, exceeding the forecasted 0.3% increase according to the Consumer Price Index report. Core inflation rose 0.3% compared to forecasts of a 0.2% gain, following Tuesday's Consumer Price Index report. Gold prices dropped 2% on Tuesday following the release of the inflation data. Central banks and the broader official sector purchased 675 tonnes of gold so far this year, marking a 6% increase compared to the same period in 2025. Fawad Razaqzada, Market Analyst at FOREX.com, identified the critical support zone for gold as the area between $3,942 and $4,000 an ounce.

stories.headline: Crude oil rebounds as expectations for an imminent deal fade amid the lack of US-Iran progress
stories.text: Crude oil prices are edging higher due to a lack of concrete breakthroughs in US-Iran negotiations. Qatar stated that at least two weeks were secured for diplomatic efforts while significant differences remain. Crude oil fell significantly after the US midterm elections based on assumptions that Republican losses would force Trump to end the Iran war quickly. The crude oil CFD contract is rising back above the key 87.00 handle on the daily chart. Sellers want the price to fall back below the trendline and the 87.00 handle to target the 80.00 level. The latest US Jobless Claims figures will be released tomorrow. The week concludes with the release of the US PPI data on Friday.

stories.headline: Global gold price drop 2026: Yellow metal slips 6% in dollar terms, but top Indian gold ETFs still deliver 7.5% returns
stories.text: Global gold prices declined by over 6% in 2026, trading at around $4,045 per troy ounce on 11 November according to TradingView data. Top-performing Indian gold ETFs delivered positive returns of over 7.5% this year despite the correction in global gold prices. A weaker Indian rupee against the US dollar cushions falling international gold prices and supports domestic prices because India imports most of its gold. Global gold ETFs recorded cumulative net inflows of $1.2 billion through 23 October, with aggregate holdings increasing by approximately 10 tonnes in October. Among top performers, 360 ONE Gold ETF delivered a 7.54% return, while Choice Gold ETF delivered 6.68% as of 9 November 2026. The October gold correction was driven by rising oil prices, persistent inflation, tighter US monetary policy expectations, and elevated real bond yields. Quantum Mutual Fund stated that fundamentals supporting gold remain intact, supported by elevated government debt, global economic uncertainty, and geopolitical tensions.

stories.headline: Gold flowing through Punjab’s five rivers? Maryam Nawaz reveals Pakistan’s untapped mineral wealth
stories.text: Pakistan’s Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz stated on Thursday that gold is flowing through the five rivers of Punjab, indicating untapped mineral wealth. Maryam Nawaz noted significant evidence of placer gold in the rivers of Punjab, particularly around Mianwali and Attock. Maryam Nawaz mentioned that Chiniot possesses an estimated 261.5 million tonnes of iron ore deposits. Maryam Nawaz outlined government incentives for mining investors, including concessional financing of up to Rs5 billion and one-window facilitation to simplify approvals. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar stated at the forum that Pakistan’s mineral resources can help transform its economy. Ishaq Dar stressed that Pakistan must develop processing, refining, and manufacturing industries instead of simply extracting and exporting raw minerals.

stories.headline: India’s Russian fossil fuel imports hit record €6.4 billion in October, crude oil accounts for 91%
stories.text: India's purchases of Russian fossil fuels reached a record €6.4 billion in October according to CREA. Crude oil accounted for 91 per cent of India's Russian fossil fuel imports, totalling EUR 5.8 billion. India's imports of Russian crude oil rose 10% month-on-month in October 2026. China remained the largest global buyer of Russian fossil fuels with purchases worth EUR 10.7 billion in October. The European Union was the third-largest buyer of Russian fossil fuels with purchases of EUR 2.2 billion in October 2026. The discount on Urals crude against global benchmark Brent averaged USD 23 a barrel in October.

stories.headline: India overtakes Taiwan to become world’s fifth-largest stock market after $640-billion rebound
stories.text: India has overtaken Taiwan to become the world's fifth-largest stock market with a market capitalization of $5.4 trillion, according to Bloomberg data. India's market capitalisation has increased by approximately $640 billion since late October following a rebound in domestic shares. The Nifty 50 closed at 25,255.05 on Wednesday, marking an increase of 9.55 per cent so far in November. Foreign portfolio investors bought a net ₹65,735 crore worth of Indian equities between November and November 11, reversing previous trends. Domestic institutional investors sold shares worth ₹40,504 crore in November through November 11, according to provisional exchange data. Second-quarter earnings of 35 Nifty 50 companies grew 22 per cent year-on-year, supporting the latest market recovery.

stories.headline: What's gold price future in India? Will it touch ₹1.50 lakh per 10 grams again by December 2026? Experts' view
stories.text: Gold prices on the Multi Commodity Exchange trade near ₹ 1,38,500 per 10 grams, while international spot gold hovers around $3,955 per ounce. SEBI-registered research analyst Anuj Gupta stated that gold faces selling pressure amid expectations of a 50-basis-point interest rate hike by the US Federal Reserve. Crude oil prices declined from around $118 to $92 per barrel due to progress in US-Iran diplomatic efforts. Kaynat Chainwala, AVP - Commodity Research at Kotak Neo, noted that gold prices need to gain around 8% from nearly ₹ 1.385 lakh per 10 grams to reach the ₹ 1.50 lakh target by December 2026. Anuj Gupta identified $3,800 per ounce as a crucial support level for international gold prices, warning of a potential decline to $3,400 per ounce if breached. Kaveri More, Commodity Technical Analyst at Choice Broking, stated that sustaining above the ₹ 142,800– ₹ 146,100 breakout range is crucial for strengthening recovery momentum.

stories.headline: Australian Gold and Copper reports ‘exceptional’ grades at Evergreen
stories.text: Australian Gold and Copper reported high-grade copper and gold results from the Evergreen prospect at the South Cobar Project in New South Wales. Drill hole EGRC018 returned 16 metres at 2.3 grams per tonne gold, 70 grams per tonne silver, 1.4 percent copper, 8 percent zinc, and 4.1 percent lead from 112 metres. Managing Director Glen Diemar described hole EGRC018 as an exceptional hole yielding an outstanding result at shallow depths. Australian Gold and Copper expects the recent drilling campaign of 21 holes and 2,593 metres to contribute to an initial mineral resource estimate for Evergreen. Australian Gold and Copper has reported assays for 18 holes out of the campaign, with the final three holes still pending. Australian Gold and Copper intends to mobilize a higher-capacity reverse circulation rig to Evergreen later in the quarter after receiving regulatory approvals for a third drilling phase.

stories.headline: OPEC October Output Rose 2 Million Bpd as Brent Fell Below $90
stories.text: OPEC+ crude output rose by 2.04 million barrels per day in October to reach 41.23 million barrels per day. Brent crude settled at $91.49 on November 10 after falling below $90 for the first time since August. Saudi Arabia led the production recovery, with direct-communication figures reporting 10.563 million barrels per day. Iraq contributed the second-largest gain by adding 496,000 barrels per day to reach 4.49 million barrels per day. Iran was the sole major OPEC member to cut output in October, with production falling by 44,000 barrels per day to roughly 1.91 million barrels per day. Saudi Arabia reported third-quarter oil revenue at 116.5 billion riyals, marking a 23% drop compared to the same period a year earlier.

stories.headline: US October PPI Preview: Fed Rate Hike Expectations Rise, PPI May Be Key Variable; How Will US Stocks, Dollar, and Gold Move?
stories.text: The United States October Producer Price Index is scheduled for release on Friday, November 13 Eastern Time. A Dow Jones survey projects the headline Producer Price Index to increase by 0.4% month-over-month in October, slowing from 1.3% in September. Core Producer Price Index excluding food and energy is projected to rise 0.3% month-over-month in October, down from 0.7% in September. As of November 12, interest rate futures implied a 90.8% probability of a 25-basis-point rate hike and a 9.2% probability of a 50-basis-point hike in December. The U.S. Dollar Index touched 103.02 on November 12, marking its highest level since April 2025. Gold prices fell to $3,875 on November 12, which was a more than one-week low.

stories.headline: Sensex Expiry Today Prediction 12 November Thursday: What should be your trading strategy? Check support, resistance
stories.text: Indian stock market benchmarks extended their winning streak on November 12, with the Sensex rising 239 points to 82,118.45 and the Nifty 50 gaining 57 points to 25,331.85. Foreign institutional investors purchased equities worth ₹ 12,563 crore on November 11, while domestic institutional investors recorded net sales of ₹ 8,434 crore. Geojit Investments Limited Chief Investment Strategist V K Vijayakumar stated that the Nifty rallied 9.55% in seven trading sessions in November. Choice Equity Broking Vice President of Technical Research Sachin Gupta stated that the 81,300–81,500 zone served as an important support area for the Sensex, while 82,400–82,500 acted as immediate resistance. The Relative Strength Index for the Sensex stood at 81.34, which was significantly above its RSI-based moving average of 63.91. The put-call ratio for the Sensex stood at 1.21, according to the derivatives data reported.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty open largely unchanged day after sharp rally amid easing crude oil prices
stories.text: Sensex and Nifty opened largely unchanged on Thursday after a sharp rally driven by foreign fund inflows, easing crude oil prices, and a cooling global artificial intelligence trade. GIFT Nifty futures stood at 25,270 at 8 am, and the Nifty 50 closed at 25,255.05 on Wednesday. Foreign portfolio investors bought shares worth ₹ 12,563 crore on Wednesday, bringing their November net purchases to $6.43 billion. Brent crude futures declined more than 1% to $91.8 per barrel due to hopes of progress in Middle East, Russia, and Ukraine peace talks. HST Wealth founder and CEO Hariselvan Radhakrishnan stated that lower crude prices provide support, but a US 10-year Treasury yield near 4.99 per cent may restrict immediate upside. MSCI added Adani Green Energy, Coforge, Life Insurance Corporation of India, and Meesho to the MSCI India index while removing PI Industries.

stories.headline: Peru's mining exports hit $57.5 billion in eight months, with copper and gold driving a 55% year-over-year surge
stories.text: Peru's mining exports reached US$21.649 billion in the first three months of 2026, marking a 56.2% increase compared to the same period in 2025, according to the Ministry of Energy and Mines. Copper exports from Peru reached US$22.843 billion through July 2026, representing a 54.7% jump over the same period in 2025, with China absorbing 73.2% of the exported value. Cumulative Peruvian mining exports crossed US$42.221 billion by the end of June 2026, a 56% advance compared with the first half of 2025, as stated by SNMPE data. Gold exports reached US$21.631 billion between January and August 2026, showing an increase of 58% from the previous year's comparable period. Copper generated US$26.513 billion in export value between January and August 2026, which was up 54.8% compared to the same window in 2025. In 2025, Peru's total exports reached a historic US$90.082 billion, representing a 21% year-on-year increase and the country's fifth straight year of record export growth, according to ADEX.

stories.headline: Gold miners enjoy strong Q2 despite lower gold price, higher expenses and operational disruptions – WGC’s Blagden
stories.text: Metals Focus Mine Supply Analyst Oliver Blagden reported that global average gold producer All-In Sustaining Costs rose by 8% quarter-on-quarter and 22% year-on-year to a record US$1,930/oz in the second quarter of 2026. Sustaining capital expenditure drove higher AISC by climbing 34% from the first quarter and 25% year-on-year to a record level of $441/oz. Metals Focus' Gold Mine Cost Service covered operations that experienced a production recovery of 1.6% quarter-on-quarter with average grades improving by 1.4%, though annual output and grade dropped by 4.4% and 3.1% year-on-year. Oliver Blagden noted that Cash Operating Costs climbed 6% quarter-on-quarter and 18% year-on-year to US$1,215/oz, while Total Cash Costs increased 4% quarter-on-quarter and 22% year-on-year to US$1,406/oz due to labor and fuel pressures. Average royalty and production-tax costs fell by 11% quarter-on-quarter to US$185/oz, which provided partial support as gold prices declined. The gold price averaged US$4,266/oz in the third quarter of 2026, marking a 5.5% quarter-on-quarter decrease, and stood at approximately US$4,040/oz at the time of writing.

stories.headline: EIA sees Brent near $100/bbl through yearend 2026 as Middle East supply constraints persist
stories.text: The US Energy Information Administration stated in its November Short-Term Energy Outlook that global crude oil prices are expected to stay near $100/bbl through the end of 2026 due to Middle East supply disruptions. Brent crude oil spot prices are forecast by the US Energy Information Administration to average about $100/bbl in November and December. Brent crude oil averaged $124/bbl in October, marking an increase of $10/bbl from September and reaching the highest monthly average since July 2022 on an inflation-adjusted basis. US crude oil production is forecast by the US Energy Information Administration to average a record 13.9 million b/d in 2026 and rise to 14.3 million b/d in 2027. US commercial crude inventories dropped by 14.1 million bbl in October to approximately 410 million bbl, which is the lowest end-of-October level since 2014. Henry Hub spot prices are forecast by the US Energy Information Administration to average $2.87/MMbtu from November through March.

stories.headline: EIA raises November natural gas storage forecast after warm start to month
stories.text: The U.S. Energy Information Administration stated that November natural gas storage will be nearly 70 billion cubic feet higher than its October forecast. The U.S. Energy Information Administration projects the Henry Hub natural gas spot price will average $2.87 per million British thermal units from November through March. The U.S. Energy Information Administration projects Brent crude oil spot prices will average $104 per barrel in November and $99 per barrel in December. The U.S. Energy Information Administration forecasts diesel will average $5.03 per gallon and gasoline will average $3.73 per gallon. The U.S. Energy Information Administration expects U.S. crude oil production to reach a record 14.3 million barrels per day in 2027. The U.S. Energy Information Administration forecasts U.S. electric power sector generation will reach a record of almost 4,390 billion kilowatthours in 2026.

stories.headline: Diesel still costing close to a ‘dismal’ £2 a litre despite oil price falls
stories.text: The price of diesel on UK forecourts remains close to the record high of £2 per litre despite a sharp fall in oil prices. According to the AA, a litre of diesel costs an average of 197p. Petrol has fallen by 6p to 168p from its peak of 174.7p reached in early October. US Federal Reserve governor Christopher Waller stated at a conference in London that energy prices could remain elevated. Christopher Waller stated that ship insurance and ship-to-ship oil transfers to guard against Iranian attacks are boosting oil prices by $20 to $30 a barrel. The AA stated that another 10p reduction could happen for petrol because wholesale costs were falling.

stories.headline: CoreWeave provides silver lining for neoclouds as Nvidia storm swirls
stories.text: CoreWeave shares rose over 16% in premarket trading overnight after reporting a 168% increase in third-quarter revenue. CoreWeave shares are down 65% from their May highs and have lost over 40% of their value in the past month. Nvidia shares extended premarket gains by rising just over 3%. Anthropic is offering 825 million shares within a price range of $70 to $78 per share. Anthropic plans to price its share offering on November 18 and begin trading on November 19. The U.S. House of Representatives voted 211 to 204 to refer the impeachment resolution for Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to a committee.

stories.headline: India emerges as standout emerging market after US midterm elections: Shriram Research
stories.text: India became a standout emerging market after the US midterm elections, with the Nifty gaining 6.8 per cent. India’s 10-year government bond yield declined by 12.5 basis points according to Shriram Research. The expansion of India's data centre capacity by 2030 involves an estimated investment of around $36 billion. Shriram Research attributed India’s performance to falling crude oil prices and capital rotation from AI-linked stocks in the US, South Korea and Taiwan. India’s two-year government bond yield declined by 17.1 basis points by the November 6 close. Shriram Research reported that India’s market gains depend on de-escalation between the US and Iran as crude oil prices recovered.

stories.headline: Oil prices, rural stress cloud outlook for consumer goods makers despite volume growth
stories.text: Crude oil prices rose 34% from the end of February to the end of September. Hindustan Unilever Ltd reported underlying volume growth of 7% in the September quarter. Tata Consumer Products Ltd reported 11% volume growth in its domestic business with a consolidated Ebitda margin of 14%. Marico Ltd reported a 13% volume increase for Parachute in the September quarter. Britannia Industries Ltd increased product prices by 3.5% in the September quarter. India's retail inflation rose to 5.54% in September, reaching a 22-month high.

stories.headline: Chinese Independent Refiners Snap Up Brazilian Crude as Freight Costs Ease
stories.text: Chinese independent refiners purchased millions of barrels of Brazilian crude oil in recent deals according to traders. Easing freight rates improved the economics of long-haul shipments for Chinese independent refiners. Chinese independent refiners rushed to use their annual import quotas before the end of the year. Purchases of Brazilian crude reflect a shift away from Russian crude by Chinese independent refiners. Persistently high prices for Russia's ESPO blend prompted Chinese refiners to seek alternative supplies from Brazil and other producers.

stories.headline: CMCL: Higher gold prices cushioned Q3 production setbacks as recovery work advanced
stories.text: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc reported lower production for the third quarter of 2026 due to operating constraints at Blanket. A stronger gold price helped Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc lift revenue and gross profit in the third quarter of 2026. Derivative remeasurement led to a reduction in net income for Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc during the period. Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc added compressors and plant capacity to support the recovery work. Bilboes remains the growth priority for Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc.

stories.headline: Chennai Petro, ONGC, Oil India fall up to 3% amid declining crude oil prices
stories.text: Shares of Chennai Petroleum Corporation, Oil and Natural Gas Corporation, and Oil India fell by up to 3 percent on Thursday. The Nifty Oil and Gas index traded 0.73 percent lower with 12 out of 15 constituents trading in the red. Chennai Petroleum Corporation shares fell 3 percent, Oil India declined 1.4 percent, and Oil and Natural Gas Corporation was down 0.82 percent. Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals slipped 1.5 percent and Panama Petrochem shares fell 0.28 percent. Brent crude futures fell more than 1 percent to USD 91.8 per barrel due to hopes of progress in peace talks in the Middle East and between Russia and Ukraine.

stories.headline: Palm Oil Market Analysis – Futures Rebound on Vegoil and Crude Support
stories.text: Nearby palm oil contracts on the Malaysian derivatives exchange rallied mid-week with front months gaining about 3.5% after earlier steep losses. The November 2026 contract on the Malaysian exchange climbed by MYR 116 to reach approximately MYR 4,156/t. Malaysian palm oil exports during the first 10 days of November slipped by nearly 2% compared to the previous month's period. Chicago soybean futures and soybean oil strengthened after the latest WASDE report reduced expectations for US ending stocks. Forecasts indicate cool, wet conditions with above-average rainfall in Argentina, Paraguay and southern Brazil during the second half of November due to El Nino.

stories.headline: China's gold jewelry prices fall below 1,200 yuan per gram, down over 500 yuan this year
stories.text: Listed prices for pure gold jewelry at major Chinese brands fell collectively on November 12, with retail prices breaking below the 1,200 yuan per gram threshold. Chow Tai Fook pure gold jewelry was priced at 1,199 yuan per gram on November 12, down 16 yuan from the previous day. Gold jewelry prices in China have fallen by more than 500 yuan per gram cumulatively this year compared to highs of 1,700 yuan per gram on January 29. The international gold price surged intraday to a historic peak of $5,598 per ounce on January 29 before entering a sustained downtrend. Some analysts stated that the correction reflects concentrated liquidation of prior long positions and the fading of safe-haven premiums.

stories.headline: How are ITC shares performing after Gold Flake Regular price hike by ₹10 per pack? Should you buy stock? Experts views
stories.text: ITC shares opened higher at ₹287.40 per share on the NSE during Thursday's Opening Bell and touched an intraday high of ₹290.25. ITC raised the price of Gold Flake Regular by ₹10 per pack to ₹135. Avinash Mentor Research Founder Avinash Gorakshkar stated that ITC cigarette holds more than three-fourths of the market share. Choice Broking Executive Director Sumeet Bagagia recommended buying ITC shares at the current market price for a target of ₹320 with a stop-loss at ₹270. Gold Flake Regular accounts for around 30-35% of ITC's total cigarette volumes.

stories.headline: GIFT Nifty up, signals steady start for Sensex, Nifty; Nvidia plunges 8% after hours, crude oil falls
stories.text: GIFT Nifty traded up by 30 points, or 0.12 percent, at 25,255 around 7:45 am on Thursday. On Wednesday, the Sensex rose 0.95 percent to 81,879.40 and the Nifty gained 0.84 percent to 25,255.05. Foreign institutional investors bought equities worth Rs 12,563 crore on Wednesday, while domestic institutional investors sold shares worth Rs 8,434 crore. Nvidia shares plunged more than 8 percent in after-hours trading amid reports regarding chief executive Jensen Huang. India's October Consumer Price Index inflation data is scheduled for release on Thursday.

stories.headline: Copper recovers with AI hopes, but gold slips
stories.text: Gold decreased by 1.2% to US$3,985 an ounce. Copper increased by 0.9% to US$13,805 a tonne due to renewed AI optimism. Iron ore declined by 0.6% to US$92 a tonne. Forecasts estimate a 0.4% expansion for the UK third quarter GDP September figure following a 0.5% growth in the June quarter. Forecasts indicate the Melbourne Institute monthly Consumer Inflation Expectations survey could rise to 5.4% following a 5.3% increase in October.

stories.headline: Troilus hits gold in Quebec ground marked as waste
stories.text: Troilus Mining discovered gold in past-producing ground previously treated as waste at its Quebec project. Desjardins Capital Markets mining analyst Bryce Adams stated that the results support potential resource conversion and lower strip ratios. Troilus Mining CEO Justin Reid stated confidence in the existing mine plan while evaluating opportunities to strengthen it. September's development update envisaged a 26-year operation with construction in 2027, first ore in September 2029, and commercial production in March 2030. Initial capital was estimated at about $1.43 billion or C$2 billion by Troilus Mining.

stories.headline: BMO says silver’s solar boom is fading, investment demand unlikely to compensate
stories.text: Silver prices are holding above $51 an ounce and are up 0.68% on the day. BMO Capital Markets commodity team analysts George Heppel and Helen Amos stated the gold-silver ratio is expected to trade around 85 points over the next four years, rising from 76 points currently. BMO Capital Markets analysts stated that the biggest risk for silver is losing the solar sector as its primary growth driver. BMO Capital Markets analysts noted that a price surge briefly took silver above $120 an ounce earlier this year. BMO Capital Markets indicated that investment demand will not be sufficient to offset the loss of demand from the solar sector.

stories.headline: Gas prices estimate rises for 2027, though consumers could still see relief from pain at the pump: EIA
stories.text: The Energy Information Administration projected in its November report that retail gasoline prices will be $3.73 a gallon in 2027. The Energy Information Administration raised its 2027 gasoline price estimate by 5% compared to its projection of $3.56 a gallon last month. The Energy Information Administration forecasted retail diesel prices at $5.03 a gallon in 2027, up from the prior forecast of $4.49 a gallon. The Energy Information Administration stated that global petroleum markets will experience continued supply constraints through the end of 2027. AAA data showed that the United States national average price of gas fell to $3.97 a gallon and dropped below $4 a gallon for the first time since July.

stories.headline: Germany Bets Big on Natural Gas to Keep the Lights On
stories.text: Gas-fired projects won all 5.16 gigawatts of derated capacity in Germany's first capacity auction, with over half at existing coal sites. LEAG and RWE won over 99% of the awarded capacity in Germany's auction. Germany's first auction required projects to supply at least 80% of installed capacity for 10 straight hours, preventing batteries from competing economically. Nearly 12 gigawatts of bids competed against a 4.5 gigawatt procurement target in Germany's auction. The volume-weighted average award price in Germany's auction was roughly €155,000 per derated megawatt per year, which was 36% below the ceiling.

stories.headline: Gold climbs as dollar and Treasury yields retreat ahead of US inflation data and Fed guidance
stories.text: Gold rose during Monday's US session to around $4,122, up 1.38%, supported by a weaker US dollar and falling Treasury yields. Nonfarm Payrolls increased by 165K versus a 65K forecast, while September's reading was revised to 60K from 29K. The Unemployment Rate eased to 4.1% from 4.2%. Traders are pricing an 80% chance of a December Federal Reserve rate hike. WTI oil pulled back to about $86.75 a barrel, down more than 3%.

stories.headline: RBI releases data on ECB / FCCB / RDB for September 2026
stories.text: The Reserve Bank of India released data regarding external borrowings and bonds for September 2026.

stories.headline: ANZ Warns: U.S. Inflation Pressure Is Spreading, Fed Rate Hikes May Exceed Expectations
stories.text: ANZ reported that the United States October consumer price index rose 0.4% month over month. Bart Melek at TD Securities stated that gold might retest support near $3,900 an ounce due to rising interest rate expectations. Goldman Sachs estimated that United States artificial intelligence spending will drive an 8% rise in real business fixed investment in 2027. JPMorgan calculated that cloud giants issued $232 billion of bonds and data centers issued $42 billion in the United States dollar investment-grade market this year. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing approved a $41 billion capital budget, raising its approved 2026 spending by 116% from a year earlier. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing will increase its quarterly dividend per share from NT$7 to NT$9 starting with third-quarter 2026 earnings. Bank of America maintained its Buy rating on Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing with a target price of NT$3,260. Constellation Energy received a conditional loan commitment of up to $5 billion from the United States Department of Energy.

stories.headline: Eurozone yields hold near 1-week highs; Investors weigh hawkish Fed bets
stories.text: Eurozone government bond yields remained close to their highest levels in over a week on Thursday. The benchmark German 10-year Bund yield stayed near the peak touched in the previous session. Japan's 10-year note yield stayed close to one-week highs despite the Bank of Japan's accommodative stance. Australia's benchmark 10-year yield stayed near its own one-week peak. The U.S. dollar remained near a one-month high against major peers during early Europe trading. The global duration sell-off stems from a hawkish recalibration of U.S. monetary policy expectations after Tuesday's October inflation report. U.S. central bank officials raised concerns over entrenched inflation and mentioned the possibility of a 50-basis-point increase in December. New York Fed President John Williams is scheduled to appear on a panel late Thursday.

stories.headline: Treasury Yields Rise Before Inflation and Housing Reports
stories.text: U.S. Treasury yields increased on Thursday as bond trading restarted after the Veterans Day market closure. The benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury note yield climbed by 2 basis points to reach 5.0100%. The 2-year U.S. Treasury note yield advanced by 5 basis points to stand at 4.7800%. The 30-year U.S. Treasury note yield remained unchanged at 5.3503%. The October producer price inflation report is projected to show a 0.4% increase following a 1.3% surge in September. Existing home sales increased by 1.5% in September to reach 3.99 million units. U.S. West Texas Intermediate futures increased by less than 0.1% to settle at $86.59 per barrel. Brent crude oil futures rose by 0.17% to reach $92.92 per barrel.

stories.headline: Japan top currency diplomat says yen’s recent fall ‘too rapid’
stories.text: Japan and the US executed a joint intervention earlier in 2026 to prevent further depreciation of the yen. Atsushi Mimura stated on Nov 12 that the yen has fallen too rapidly in recent days as it approached 160 against the US dollar. The US dollar traded around the mid-159 yen line following Atsushi Mimura's comments on Nov 12.
