Dealers reported that growing expectations of a US Federal Reserve key interest rate hike boosted the dollar overnight due to stronger US consumer inflation data. Financial markets anticipate the Bank of Japan to raise interest rates as early as the December meeting because inflation remains entrenched. The Bank of Japan maintains a current policy rate of 1.25%, which remains lower than the rates in the US and Europe. Japan suffered economic blows from high energy prices caused by Middle East tensions and a weak yen that inflates import costs. Japan previously intervened in the foreign exchange market, including a joint action with the US on July 31, after the yen dropped beyond 163 per dollar.

stories.headline: CPI | AkzoNobel-Axalta $25 Billion Deal Hits UK Regulatory Roadblock
stories.text: AkzoNobel and Axalta Coating Systems face a deeper regulatory investigation in Britain regarding their proposed $25 billion merger from the Competition and Markets Authority. The Competition and Markets Authority stated on Wednesday that the merger could reduce competition in the market for automotive repair coatings. The Competition and Markets Authority gave AkzoNobel and Axalta until November 18 to propose measures addressing the regulatory concerns. The combined company would generate approximately $17 billion in annual revenue across automotive, aerospace, industrial, marine, and decorative paint markets. The Competition and Markets Authority found that the combined entity would hold an estimated 40% to 50% share of the UK supply for vehicle-refinish coatings. AkzoNobel and Axalta plan to address British concerns using a divestiture arrangement negotiated with European Union regulators. The European Commission conditionally approved the transaction last week after the companies agreed to dispose of European vehicle-refinish coatings assets. AkzoNobel and Axalta maintain their expectation that the transaction will close by early 2027.

stories.headline: Bank of England’s inflation response ‘risks higher interest rates for longer’
stories.text: The National Institute of Economic and Social Research stated that the Bank of England risks keeping interest rates higher for longer following a hesitant response to rising inflation. The Bank of England increased the cost of borrowing from 3.75% to 4%. UK inflation stands at 3.5%, which is above the Bank of England's 2% target. Brent crude oil traded below $90 at one point, which was the lowest since 31 August. The S&P 500 index decreased by 0.9% by early afternoon on Wall Street. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research expects the UK economy to grow by 1.6% this year. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research expects the UK economy to grow by only 0.9% in 2028. Chancellor John Healey was criticized for deferring difficult decisions in the budget last month.

stories.headline: U.S. October CPI Beats Expectations, Sparking Bond Market Selloff; 10-Year Yield Briefly Tops 5%
stories.text: The U.S. Labor Department reported that the headline consumer price index rose 0.4% month-over-month in October. Core CPI rose 0.3% month-over-month in October, exceeding the expected 0.2%. The 10-year Treasury yield briefly broke through the 5% psychological threshold before settling at 4.996% on Tuesday. The 2-year Treasury yield soared 18.46 basis points to 4.742% on Tuesday. Wall Street traders are fully pricing in at least a quarter-point rate hike in December with a 10% to 15% probability of a half-point increase. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated before the data release that a core CPI month-over-month pace of roughly 0.3% could necessitate more forceful policy action. The U.S. Treasury auctioned $42 billion of 10-year notes at a high yield of 5.020% on Tuesday. Lorie Logan, president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas, stated that the Federal Reserve may need to pick up the pace.

stories.headline: Euro holds ground against Canadian Dollar amid weaker oil prices
stories.text: The EUR/CAD currency cross traded around 1.5840 during European hours on Wednesday following minor losses in the previous day. Final German Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices data confirmed a 0.1% monthly contraction and 2.8% year-on-year growth for October. September German Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices data showed respective increases of 0.6% and 3.3%. Deutsche Bank analysts reported a major selloff for European sovereign bonds as investors priced in a more hawkish European Central Bank trajectory. West Texas Intermediate oil prices traded around $85.20 per barrel while losing ground for the fourth successive day. Crude oil prices depreciated following signs of easing tensions between the United States and Iran. Donald Trump suggested that additional military strikes against Iran may no longer be necessary.

stories.headline: Inflation Fears Keep Treasury Yields Elevated, but Is the Market Overreacting?
stories.text: The average fair-value estimate for the US 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.35% in October based on three models used by The Capital Spectator. The market yield for the US 10-year Treasury note climbed to average above 5.0% in October for the first time since 2002. Estimated annual inflation accelerated to 4.0% for headline Consumer Price Index in October, reaching the highest reading since May. Core Consumer Price Index rose to an estimated 2.9% in October, marking a 13-month high. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that economic pressure on Iran is devastating and eliminates the current need for major combat operations. U.S. President Donald Trump cited positive momentum toward resolving the conflict involving Iran. Fed funds futures priced in a roughly 90% probability that the Federal Reserve will raise its target interest rate by a quarter point at the Dec. 9 FOMC meeting.

stories.headline: As higher prices seep into broader economy, U.S. Fed officials consider faster hikes
stories.text: U.S. government data reported that inflation increased to four per cent in October compared to the previous year, rising from 3.7 per cent in September. Lorie Logan, president of the U.S. Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas, stated on Tuesday that she supported two additional quarter-point rate hikes and that the U.S. Federal Reserve could move more rapidly this winter. At its meeting in late October, the U.S. Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged at approximately 3.9 per cent. Anna Paulson, president of the Philadelphia Fed, stated in a late Tuesday speech that underlying inflation remains above target and has not declined. U.S. government data indicated that smartphone prices jumped 1.4 per cent from September to October, marking the largest increase on record. Christopher Waller noted in a London speech that 70 per cent of services prices increased by three per cent or more in September compared to a year earlier. Michelle Bowman stated in a Tuesday speech at the Council on Foreign Relations that price pressures may be broadening beyond a few concentrated categories.

stories.headline: Inflation seen hitting RBI's 6% ceiling in October, putting rate policy in focus
stories.text: India's retail inflation is projected to reach 6% in October according to a Mint poll of 15 economists, up from 5.5% in September. The official Consumer Price Index data for October is scheduled to be released by the government on 12 November. The Reserve Bank of India raised the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5% in its October policy review. IDFC First Bank chief economist Gaura Sengupta stated an expectation for the Reserve Bank of India to hike policy rates by 25 bps in December. Icra chief economist Aditi Nayar noted that the food and beverages division is expected to record inflation exceeding 8% in October. The Reserve Bank of India raised its inflation projection for the 2026-27 period to 5.2% from 5% in its October monetary policy review. The Reserve Bank of India expects inflation to average 6% in the October-December quarter before moderating to 5.7% in January-March.

stories.headline: Hot US inflation report seals Federal Reserve rate increase
stories.text: US Consumer Price Index inflation increased by 0.4 per cent monthly in October, which was slower than the 0.6 pace in September. About 90 per cent of traders expect the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates by 25 basis points at its December meeting. Federal Reserve governor Christopher Waller stated he would support a 50 basis point rate increase next month if October inflation held firm. Dallas Fed president Lorie Logan stated she supports raising the interest rate at least two more times. Christopher Waller stated that maritime insurance and ship-to-ship oil transfers are raising oil prices by between $20 and $30 a barrel. The yield on the 10-year Treasury climbed back to 5 per cent following the Consumer Price Index inflation report. The yield on the 30-year Treasury rose more than 10 basis points to reach 5.36 per cent.

stories.headline: Interest rates should rise to 5% to control inflation, says think tank
stories.text: The National Institute of Economic and Social Research stated that interest rates in the UK need to rise to 5% to properly control inflation. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research forecasts that UK Consumer Prices Index inflation will peak at approximately 4.4% in February. The Bank of England raised UK interest rates to 4% last week in response to rising inflation. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research expects UK inflation will not return to the 2% target until late 2030. Chancellor John Healey confirmed in last month's autumn Budget that the UK fiscal headroom will decrease to £14.5 billion. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research forecasts UK gross domestic product growth at 1.6% for this year. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research projects that UK gross domestic product growth will slow to 1.1% next year.

stories.headline: India's retail inflation jumps to 6.09% in October against 5.54% in September, breaches RBI threshold
stories.text: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October compared to 5.54% in September, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit of 6%. Food inflation increased to 8.94% in October from 7.74% in September, driven by higher prices for onions, garlic, and ginger. The October retail inflation rate exceeded the 5.93% prediction from a Reuters poll of economists. Retail inflation stayed above the Reserve Bank of India's medium-term target of 4% for five consecutive months. Transport inflation increased to 5.84% in October, creating additional pressure on household expenses. Under the Reserve Bank of India's framework, a formal target failure occurs only when average inflation stays above the upper tolerance limit for three consecutive quarters.

stories.headline: Rupiah’s drop to record low spurs Bank Indonesia intervention
stories.text: The 10-year bond yield climbed four basis points to 7.66%. Bank Indonesia is intervening in multiple markets and via government bond purchases to stabilise the rupiah. Erwin Hutapea stated on Nov 12 that Bank Indonesia remains present to maintain the rupiah exchange rate stability. The rupiah has weakened more than 8% against the US dollar in 2026. Goldman Sachs Group estimated about US$5.6 billion of passive outflows if Indonesian stocks are removed from MSCI indexes. Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned amid calls for his impeachment.

stories.headline: Inflation rises to 2.8% in Oct. as energy prices climb 12.2% in Germany
stories.text: The inflation rate in Germany reached 2,8 percent in October 2026 based on final data from Destatis. German energy prices increased by 12,2 percent in October 2026 compared to the same month in the previous year. German food prices increased by 0,4 percent in October 2026, staying below the overall inflation rate. Prices for goods in Germany increased by 3 percent year-over-year in October 2026. Prices in the German services sector went up by 2,5 percent compared to October 2025. Eurozone inflation accelerated to 4% in October, marking its highest level in three years according to Qazinform News Agency.

stories.headline: The 2-Year Treasury Yield Just Had Its Biggest Jump in 19 Months
stories.text: Federal Reserve governor Christopher Waller stated in London that a 50 basis point rate hike should be considered for December if October core CPI hit 0.3% or higher. October core CPI rose 0.3% for the third straight month, missing the 0.2% expectation. Goldman Sachs added a second quarter-point rate rise to its forecast, likely for March 2027. The iShares 1-3 Year Treasury Bond ETF fell 0.33% to $81.32, and the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF fell 1.32% to $80.88. Futures priced a 91% chance of a 25-basis-point December rise and a 9% chance for a half point. The 10-year Treasury yield rose 10 basis points to reach 4.98%.

stories.headline: Moody’s ups growth forecast for India to 7%, cautions high inflation
stories.text: Moody's Ratings raised India's growth forecast to 7 per cent for fiscal year 2026-27, up from its previous 6.5 per cent projection. The Reserve Bank of India increased its real GDP growth forecast for the 2026-27 financial year to 7.1 per cent. The World Bank raised India's growth forecast for the current fiscal year by 50 basis points to 7.1 per cent. Moody's Ratings warned that a potential policy interest rate hike could impact private investment in India. Moody's Ratings noted that headline inflation in India is currently close to the upper end of the Reserve Bank of India's 2-6 per cent target range. The Reserve Bank of India projected Consumer Price Index inflation for 2026-27 to be 5.2 per cent.

stories.headline: Oil: Hormuz mine strikes support Brent rebound – Commerzbank
stories.text: Commerzbank Research reported escalating tensions in the Strait of Hormuz involving mine strikes on tankers and disrupted LNG flows. Iran's IRGC Navy claimed that two additional oil tankers struck mines while trying to transit the waterway and both vessels were on fire. Brent crude increased by 1.2% to reach USD92.63 due to the Strait of Hormuz mine incidents providing a price floor. Brent crude experienced a broader November decline of approximately 17%.

stories.headline: ITC Gold Flake Premium cigarettes get costlier: New prices to burn a hole in your pocket as pack of 10 rises to ₹135
stories.text: ITC Ltd. increased the maximum retail price of Gold Flake Premium cigarettes by ₹ 10 per pack. A 10-cigarette pack of the regular-size variant now costs ₹ 135 instead of ₹ 125 previously. ITC Ltd. implemented a prior price revision for the brand in June when the price rose from ₹ 115 to ₹ 125. Net revenue from cigarettes dropped by 21% during the September quarter for ITC Ltd.

stories.headline: Singapore opens gold vault to foreign central banks in race to become Asia’s gold hub
stories.text: Singapore has made its national gold vault accessible to foreign central banks. Analysts believe this initiative will intensify Singapore's competition with Hong Kong to become Asia's primary bullion hub. The Monetary Authority of Singapore stated it will store gold for overseas central banks, sovereign entities, and international financial institutions in its currency vault. The storage facility has a capacity of 500 tonnes and includes potential for future expansion.

stories.headline: Gold Extends Fall Below $4,000 as Market Watches Fed
stories.text: Gold prices dropped for the third consecutive day. The decline pushed prices past the threshold of $4,000 an ounce. Hawkish comments made by Federal Reserve officials also drove the drop in gold prices. Market expectations for a series of interest-rate hikes were reinforced by the inflation data and official remarks.

stories.headline: Gold Prices Recover Above $4,040 as Investors Assess Federal Reserve Rate Hike Expectations
stories.text: Spot gold rose 0.22% to $4,041.67 per ounce on Wednesday, while US gold futures gained 0.48% to $4,049.52 per ounce. Bullion had declined 2.6% following the release of October's US Consumer Price Index report. The US Dollar Index increased 0.02% to 102.27 during Wednesday's session. Spot silver gained 1.6% to $52.3730 per ounce and spot platinum rose 1.7% to $1,566.42 per ounce on Wednesday.

stories.headline: RBI to conduct Overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction under LAF on November 12, 2026
stories.text: The Reserve Bank of India decided to hold the Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction following a review of current and evolving liquidity conditions. The auction window timing is scheduled from 10:45 AM to 11:15 AM on November 12, 2026, with the reversal date set for November 13, 2026.

stories.headline: FII drive Nifty rally; all eyes on inflation print
stories.text: The BSE Sensex opened at 81,762.27 and traded up 128.71 points at 82,008.11 in early trade on Thursday. HDFC Life Insurance led Nifty 50 gainers with a 2.81 per cent increase to ₹589.65. Mahindra & Mahindra experienced the steepest decline on the Nifty, falling 1.56 per cent to ₹3,411.00. Foreign institutional investors purchased equities worth ₹12,563 crore on November 11. MCX December gold was quoted at ₹1,39,730 per 10 grams, dropping ₹795 or 0.57 per cent.

stories.headline: CDL shares fall 8% after developer warns of significantly weaker second half
stories.text: City Developments Limited stated that persistent inflation and elevated interest rates delayed expected deal completions for 2026. City Developments Limited booked a $473.1 million gain in the second half of 2025 from selling its South Beach Consortium stake. City Developments Limited warned that foreign exchange losses, particularly from the Korean won, will weigh on earnings. City Developments Limited and its joint venture partners sold 124 units worth $322.6 million in the third quarter. City Developments Limited reported a net gearing of 75% as at Sept 30, with a target to reach 55% by 2029.

stories.headline: NIESR urges Bank of England to push rates to 5% as inflation threatens to linger until 2030
stories.text: The National Institute of Economic and Social Research urged the Bank of England to raise interest rates from 4% to 5%. NIESR's autumn report projects that price growth may not return to the 2% target until 2030. NIESR calculated that fiscal pressure amounts to a potential £30bn spending test facing Chancellor John Healey and Andy Burnham. Approximately three-quarters of UK workers are set to agree pay settlements in the first three months of next year. NIESR estimates that raising rates to 4.75% would knock 0.4 percentage points off GDP growth in both 2028 and 2029.

stories.headline: US Treasury yields surge, Wall Street falls on inflation surprise
stories.text: US Treasury yields surged and Wall Street stocks fell on Tuesday after higher-than-expected October inflation data. The US Consumer Price Index rose 0.4 percent in October, exceeding the forecasted 0.3 percent. The two-year US Treasury yield climbed 18.44 basis points to 4.731 percent, marking its largest daily increase since April 2025. The dollar index rose 0.56 percent to 102.25 as expectations of higher interest rates boosted the currency. Spot gold fell 2.62 percent to $4,030.56 an ounce due to rising Treasury yields and a stronger US dollar.

stories.headline: Oil relief to revive rupee rally, US yields surge could act as brake
stories.text: Nimesh Vora reported from Mumbai that the Indian rupee is expected to resume its recent rally on Wednesday. Traders expect the Indian rupee to open in the 93.70 to 93.74 range against the dollar. The Indian rupee settled at 93.93275 to the dollar on Monday. Indian financial markets were shut on Tuesday for a local holiday. Brent crude slid below $90 a barrel on Tuesday for the first time since August.

stories.headline: Copper, Iron Ore and Gold Fall as Stronger Dollar and Weak Demand Weigh on Metals
stories.text: London Metal Exchange copper prices briefly fell to $13,657 a tonne near a four-month low due to renewed selling in technology stocks and a stronger US dollar. The Singapore iron ore benchmark dropped as much as 1.6% to $90.70 a tonne, marking a fourth consecutive session of price declines. Gold prices extended their decline for a third session, slipping below $4,000 an ounce amid stronger US inflation data and hawkish Federal Reserve comments.

stories.headline: Gold's performance after past Fed rate hikes: What historical data shows
stories.text: Motilal Oswal Financial Services reported that gold historically generated an average return of 4.22% in the three months and 5.84% over six months following the Federal Reserve's first rate hike. Spot gold fell below $4,000 per ounce on Thursday, November 12, reaching a more than one-week low due to stronger-than-expected US inflation data and hawkish Federal Reserve comments. For the domestic market at a USD/INR exchange rate of 96, Motilal Oswal Financial Services set an accumulation zone of ₹1.35 lakh per 10 grams and a short-term target of ₹1.48 lakh per 10 grams.

stories.headline: Crude oil faces a geopolitical test as Russia signals progress toward peace
stories.text: Vladimir Medinsky stated that Russia and Ukraine are moving closer to peace after talks in Abu Dhabi, though much depends on all participants turning optimism into concrete commitments. Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large-scale prisoner exchange following discussions in Abu Dhabi, according to Vladimir Medinsky. Crude oil reached $87.56 during trading, briefly moving above the 100 day moving average before diplomatic headlines sent it back toward $87.00.

stories.headline: Cosmo First eyes all-time high US exports from film business this fiscal on lower tariffs
stories.text: Cosmo First Ltd expects its film business to achieve record-high exports to the US in the current fiscal year. Cosmo First Ltd Group CEO Pankaj Poddar stated that US import duty on their films dropped from 55 percent to 15 percent. Pankaj Poddar stated that lower tariffs drove a sales growth of about 35 percent and projected close to $70 million in sales this fiscal year. Pankaj Poddar stated that the rigid packaging business in the US is expected to start within the next two to three months. Cosmo First Ltd vertical Cosmo Plastech recorded over 90 percent topline growth in the second quarter of the current fiscal year. Cosmo Films generates over 85 percent of total revenue for Cosmo First Ltd. Pankaj Poddar stated that the film business will grow over 20 percent and the non-film business over 60 percent this year. Zigly and Cosmo Consumer registered 47 percent and 70 percent year-on-year topline growth respectively in the second quarter of the current fiscal.

stories.headline: China Targets Global Gas Turbine Market as AI Power Demand Explodes
stories.text: China directed its domestic gas turbine manufacturers on Thursday to speed up technology development and target international data center sales. Global orders for gas turbines reached a record high driven by surging power generation demand, according to JP Morgan. JP Morgan reported that new gas turbine orders in the second quarter reached 38 gigawatts, showing a 29% increase over the first quarter. JP Morgan noted that second-quarter gas turbine orders increased by 71% on an annual basis. The United States accounted for half of the new gas turbine orders due to rising electricity demand from data centers. Wang Yunbo, deputy director of the market regulation department at the National Energy Administration, stated that wait times of over five years present an opportunity and challenge for Chinese manufacturers. Dongfang Electric Corporation signed an agreement last month with Canadian data center developer Eco DC Solutions to supply 30 gas turbines supporting over 2.1 GW. Shanghai Electric Group Co., Ltd secured a turnkey contract earlier this year to deliver gas turbines to the Samalaju Combined Cycle Power Plant in Sarawak, Malaysia.

stories.headline: Amazon-backed BankBazaar explores majority stake sale
stories.text: Online financial services provider BankBazaar is exploring a potential majority stake sale to enable early investors to exit. BankBazaar previously held buyout discussions with Juspay, though those talks did not progress. BankBazaar was last valued at approximately Rs 1,600 crore. Secondary share sales for the proposed transaction are expected to happen at a discount of around 30-35 percent. A primary capital infusion portion of the transaction is likely to be priced at a discount of around 10 percent. BankBazaar reported revenues increasing from around Rs 69 crore in FY21 to Rs 254 crore in FY25. BankBazaar reduced its losses from Rs 58 crore to Rs 23 crore between FY21 and FY25. The proposed transaction is expected to conclude by March.

stories.headline: Bharat Dynamics shares plunge 3% after defence major’s profit drops 15% to Rs 183 crore in Q2
stories.text: Bharat Dynamics Ltd shares fell over 3 percent following the release of its financial results. Bharat Dynamics Ltd reported a 15 percent year-on-year decline in profit after tax to Rs 183.5 crore for the second quarter of financial year 2026-27. Bharat Dynamics Ltd recorded a net profit of Rs 216 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal. Bharat Dynamics Ltd posted a 43.3 percent year-on-year increase in revenue from operations at Rs 1,664 crore for the quarter. Bharat Dynamics Ltd saw its EBITDA fall by 46 percent year-on-year to Rs 101 crore for the quarter ended September 2026. Bharat Dynamics Ltd experienced a contraction of 1,020 basis points in its EBITDA margin to 6.1 percent for the July-September quarter of FY27. Bharat Dynamics Ltd stock traded 3.46 percent lower at Rs 1,061 on the BSE at around 2 pm. Bharat Dynamics Ltd currently holds a market capitalisation of approximately Rs 38,934.44 crore.

stories.headline: India’s GDP growth seen at 7.7% in Q3 on strong manufacturing push
stories.text: BofA Global Research reported on Thursday that India's Q3 FY27 GDP growth is projected to reach 7.7 per cent year-on-year. BofA Global Research estimated India's Q3 GVA growth at 8.1 per cent. BofA maintains its full-year FY27 GDP growth forecast for India at 7.4 per cent. BofA projects India's GDP growth for FY28 at 7.5 per cent. India's manufacturing is expected to grow around 12 per cent in Q3 FY27. India's IIP growth is projected to rise to 7.3 per cent in Q3 from 6.2 per cent in Q2. India's bank credit growth continues at around 20 per cent. India's nominal GDP growth estimate for Q2 FY27 is around 13.9 per cent year-on-year.

stories.headline: A Billion Users Later, Is India's Telecom Challenge Still the Village?
stories.text: According to the Department of Telecommunications, the number of Indian villages without 4G coverage dropped from 45,180 in 2022 to 11,372 in 2026. By November 2026, Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited had commissioned 18,291 sites under the government's 4G Saturation Project. The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India reported that India had 1.09 billion internet subscribers at the end of March 2026. Wireless data consumption per subscriber rose to 25.51 GB per month in financial year 2026 compared to 21.53 GB in the previous financial year, according to the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India. The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India stated that the average revenue realisation per gigabyte dropped by 10.59% from ₹8.97 in financial year 2025 to ₹8.02 in financial year 2026. In October, Jio Platforms launched its ₹30,213-crore public issue, marking India's largest initial public offering. On its first day of trading, Jio Platforms recorded a market capitalisation of approximately ₹13.1 lakh crore. Elon Musk accused Indian incumbent operators of trying to block Starlink's entry into the country during October.

stories.headline: Whirlpool of India Limited Earnings Missed Analyst Estimates: Here's What Analysts Are Forecasting Now
stories.text: Whirlpool of India Limited reported a statutory earnings per share of ₹1.98 for the half-year results released last week. Whirlpool of India Limited's statutory earnings per share fell 45% below analyst forecasts. Whirlpool of India Limited's revenues were approximately in line with analyst estimates at ₹46b. Following the latest results, ten analysts are forecasting Whirlpool of India Limited revenues of ₹90.6b in 2027. Analyst consensus price target for Whirlpool of India Limited was broadly unchanged at ₹939. The most bullish analyst values Whirlpool of India Limited at ₹1,202 per share. The most bearish analyst prices Whirlpool of India Limited at ₹712 per share. Whirlpool of India Limited is expected to experience a forecast 12% annualised growth to the end of 2027.

stories.headline: Indo-German JV Benecore bets ₹200 crore on making diaper, sanitary napkin material in India
stories.text: German-Indian joint venture Benecore Pvt Ltd is investing over ₹ 200 crore to build a new manufacturing facility in Bhopal to produce nonwoven fabric used in baby diapers and sanitary napkins. Rudra Chatterjee, chairman of Benecore and the Obeetee Group, stated that the first phase of the plant is expected to generate approximately ₹ 300 crore in revenue. Benecore plans to double the facility's capacity by 2029, which would increase its revenue potential to about ₹ 600 crore, according to Rudra Chatterjee. Benecore was established in 2023 as a 50:50 joint venture between Germany's TWE Group GmbH and Obeetee Textiles, previously operating under the name TWE OBT Pvt Ltd. The Bhopal facility utilizes two production lines equipped with Air Through Bond technology to manufacture ultra-soft nonwoven material. The Bhopal factory, which was established in October, has already commenced commercial production and initiated work with major global and Indian diaper and sanitary napkin brands. Rudra Chatterjee stated that the Bhopal plant is projected to provide employment for about 150 individuals, mainly in technical and engineering positions due to high automation.

stories.headline: SBI Mutual Fund launches defence ETF fund of funds; NFO opens November 16
stories.text: SBI Mutual Fund launched the SBI BSE India Defence ETF FOF, which is an open-ended fund of funds scheme. The New Fund Offer for the SBI BSE India Defence ETF FOF is scheduled from November 16 to 30, 2026. The scheme will invest at least 95 percent of its assets in units of the SBI BSE India Defence ETF. The minimum application amount during the New Fund Offer period is set at 5,000 rupees. An exit load of 1 percent applies for redemptions made within 15 days of allotment. Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer Debasish Mishra stated that the defence sector is a critical pillar of India progress. The SBI BSE India Defence ETF FOF will be managed by Viral Chhadva.

stories.headline: Middle East war: Oil prices gain as more vessels face attacks
stories.text: Crude oil prices rose following attacks on commercial vessels in and around the Strait of Hormuz. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reported an incident involving a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. A commercial vessel was struck by an unknown projectile northeast of Lima, Oman on Tuesday. Military authorities reported a tanker on fire northwest of Khasab, Oman on Saturday, resulting in crew evacuation. Mohsen Rezaei stated that Iran will not move any of its enriched nuclear material out of the country. Yemen’s Houthi militants targeted Saudi Aramco’s Abqaiq processing facility and key transit infrastructure. The US Central Command disabled the St. Kitts-flagged M/V Huda in the Gulf of Oman on Saturday.

stories.headline: Ferrexpo halts Ukraine iron ore output after power attacks
stories.text: Ferrexpo temporarily stopped production at its Ukrainian iron ore operations after recent attacks disrupted the country's electricity infrastructure. Ferrexpo reported that damage to substations and transmission lines made electricity supplies unstable and insufficient for maintaining production. Ferrexpo stated that its mining and processing assets escaped physical damage during the attacks. Ferrexpo plans to resume production once commercial electricity supplies are restored, though no specific timetable was given. The recent stoppage marks Ferrexpo's third suspension of operations during 2026 due to power disruptions, limited working capital, and constrained export routes. Ferrexpo recorded commercial production of 780,000 tonnes in the September quarter, which was 19% lower than the 963,000 tonnes produced in the June quarter. Ferrexpo produced 2.04 million tonnes of pellets in the first nine months of 2026, marking a 27% decrease compared to the same period in 2025.

stories.headline: OpenAI now allows enterprises to process AI requests within India
stories.text: OpenAI announced local processing and inference for its API in India on November 12, 2026, allowing eligible businesses and developers to process supported AI requests within the country. The new capability builds upon OpenAI's existing data residency offering in India introduced in May 2025. Nitin Bawankule, Head of Enterprise, India, OpenAI, stated that some Indian businesses delayed AI deployment due to requirements for in-country information processing. The new local processing offering is initially available for the GPT-6 Luna model, addressing data localisation requirements in financial services and other sectors. Both API request processing and model computation for supported workloads will occur in India, with supported customer content also stored locally. OpenAI previously partnered with Tata Group to build domestic AI data-centre capacity as part of the OpenAI for India initiative. Amazon Web Services made OpenAI models available for in-country inference on the Bedrock platform in August 2026.

stories.headline: Absurd "Made in India" AI Model Exposed as Repackaged Qwen3.5: Huge Fiasco Uncovered, Even Forcing AI to Claim "Originates from India"
stories.text: Indian AI research company 169Pi officially released a multimodal reasoning model named Alpie Seed 9B on November 8. Alpie Seed 9B features 9 billion parameters, supports text, image, and video input, and includes a 262K context window. Developers analyzing configuration files discovered that Alpie Seed 9B's underlying architecture is directly derived from Alibaba's Qwen3.5-9B model. The model configuration included an identity policy prompt requiring Alpie Seed 9B to claim it was developed by Indian company 169Pi and comes from India. Independent developer Satyajit sampled and compared all 760 tensors of Alpie Seed and Qwen3.5-9B on November 9, finding that Alpie Seed retains the original architecture. On November 9, 169Pi released a statement admitting that Alpie Seed is developed based on Qwen3.5-9B and that failing to highlight the origin was an oversight. 169Pi used 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs for GRPO reinforcement learning, completing 3034 training steps and consuming about 3472 GPU hours.

stories.headline: India plans curbs on private-equity ownership of NBFCs: Report
stories.text: The Reserve Bank of India is developing proposals to stop private equity firms from having a controlling stake in more than one non-banking financial company. The Reserve Bank of India worries that financial distress at a global private equity firm could spread across multiple non-banking financial companies. Holdings of 15% or lower will be categorized as financial investments and face reduced scrutiny under the anticipated rules. A draft of the regulations will be concluded following public consultation and could be formally released early next year. Grant Thornton data shows that private equity investments into India's financial sector reached about $5.4 billion last year. Blackstone agreed to acquire a 16% stake in IIFL Finance for $535 million. Singapore's Temasek plans to invest approximately $265 million in Godrej Capital.

stories.headline: Suprajit's global business gains traction on US contract wins, China EV demand
stories.text: Suprajit Engineering expects global business growth to continue due to US contract wins and higher electric vehicle orders in China. Suprajit Engineering reported a consolidated revenue of ₹1,135.1 crore for the quarter, marking a 20.6 per cent increase year-on-year. Suprajit Engineering posted a consolidated profit after tax of ₹53.37 crore for the quarter, reflecting a 4.7 per cent year-on-year growth. The Global Cable Mechatronics business of Suprajit Engineering achieved revenue growth of approximately 24 per cent and a 69 per cent increase in EBITDA. Suprajit Engineering stated that EBITDA margins for the Global Cable Mechatronics business improved to over 10 per cent compared to 7.4 per cent in the previous year. Suprajit Engineering's export arm, Suprajit Automotice Limited, is establishing a greenfield cable manufacturing facility in Chennai. Suprajit Engineering noted that the Indian automotive industry grew by over 20 per cent during the quarter, aided by GST rate reductions.

stories.headline: Bank Nifty rises for 3rd day, trades above 61,300; PNB, AU SFB lead gains: What lies ahead?
stories.text: Bank Nifty rose for the third consecutive session on November 12, led by Punjab National Bank and AU Small Finance Bank. At 1 pm on November 12, the Bank Nifty index traded 0.9 percent higher at 61,359.25. Punjab National Bank and AU Small Finance Bank rose by 3.5 percent and 2.5 percent respectively. IndusInd Bank, State Bank of India, and Yes Bank gained 2.3 percent, 2 percent, and 1.6 percent respectively. Bajaj Broking Deputy Vice President-Research Pabitro Mukherjee stated that the index generated a breakout above the four-month range of 58,000 to 54,000. LKP Securities Technical Analyst Vatsal Bhuva stated that investors should maintain a buy-on-dips strategy as the broader trend remains positive. Choice Broking Technical Research Analyst Hitesh Tailor stated that immediate support is placed at 60,000 to 60,300.

stories.headline: Customers without bank accounts can send up to ₹50,000 with cash pay-in service, say RBI guidelines
stories.text: The Reserve Bank of India issued domestic money transfer directions for 2026 detailing rules for customers without bank accounts. The Reserve Bank of India guidelines apply to scheduled commercial banks, regional rural banks, cooperative banks, and payment system operators. Under the cash pay-out service, recipients without bank accounts can collect transferred money in cash up to ₹ 10,000 per transaction and ₹ 25,000 monthly. Under the cash pay-in service, unbanked individuals can deposit up to ₹ 50,000 per transaction into a beneficiary account using national electronic funds transfer. Transfers conducted through business correspondents, automated teller machines, and other channels carry a limit of ₹ 5,000 per transaction and a ₹ 25,000 monthly cap per sender. Senders must register using a verified mobile number and a self-certified officially valid document following the Reserve Bank of India 2025 KYC rules. The Reserve Bank of India repealed older framework reviews from 2024-25 and guidelines from 2011 with the directions issued on Wednesday.

stories.headline: Escorts Kubota expects to outperform shrinking India tractor market
stories.text: Escorts Kubota anticipates growing its market share in the weakening domestic tractor segment during fiscal 2027 by introducing new models, expanding its dealer network, and leveraging its strong presence in northern India. Chief Financial Officer Bharat Madan stated that Escorts Kubota expects domestic sales to be flat or slightly higher while overall industry volumes decline marginally. India recorded a June-September monsoon rainfall that was 12.6 per cent below normal, representing the largest shortfall since 2015. Escorts Kubota reported that its domestic sales dropped 16.2 per cent in September and 10.9 per cent in October, although sales for the April-October period were up by 6.2 per cent. During the second quarter, Escorts Kubota increased its domestic market share by 48 basis points to approximately 12.2 per cent as its volumes grew 0.9 per cent while industry sales dropped about 3 per cent. Escorts Kubota revised its industry forecast down to a marginal single-digit decline compared to its previous expectation of mid-single-digit growth. Competitor Mahindra & Mahindra also revised its industry forecast to flat from 5 per cent growth because of weak rainfall and pressure on rural purchasing power.

stories.headline: Nifty 500 at open: Cupid hits record high on 133% Q2 profit jump; ONGC falls
stories.text: Cupid shares rose 9% at market open on Thursday, November 12, to hit an all-time high of ₹389 following second-quarter financial results. Cupid reported a 133% rise in net profit to ₹56.22 crore and raised its FY27 guidance to revenue of at least ₹880 crore. Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions shares increased by 6.7% at market open on Thursday, November 12. Godrej Industries shares advanced 5.6% at market open on Thursday, November 12. Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) shares declined by 3.36% at market open after JPMorgan stated a preference for BPCL and IOC. Marico shares dropped 2% at market open on Thursday, November 12. Aurobindo Pharma shares fell 2% at market open after the US FDA classified an inspection at its arm Lannett's facility as Official Action Indicated.

stories.headline: SBI shares gain 1%, among top Nifty gainers, as brokerages bullish on loan growth, profitability outlook
stories.text: State Bank of India shares rose around 1 percent on Thursday, making the lender one of the top Nifty 50 gainers after brokerages maintained bullish views. Brokerage CLSA maintained an Outperform rating on State Bank of India with a target price of Rs 1,325 per share. State Bank of India retained its loan growth guidance of 14-15 percent, with retail, agriculture and MSME loans making up 65 percent of its domestic loan portfolio. Brokerage Goldman Sachs maintained a Buy rating on State Bank of India with a target price of Rs 1,130 per share. State Bank of India reported a 14.3 percent year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 23,038 crore for the fiscal second quarter. State Bank of India's net interest income increased by 14.7 percent to Rs 49,143 crore, surpassing the CNBC-TV18 poll estimate. State Bank of India is scheduled to meet institutional investors in Singapore on November 17 and 18 for corporate day and summit events.

stories.headline: France blames Iran for supermarket fridge hacks, seeks EU sanctions
stories.text: The French government accused Tehran of conducting cyberattacks that sabotaged supermarket refrigerators, spoiled food, and caused fires across roughly 700 commercial sites. French investigators identified Shahid Kaveh, a cyber unit linked to Iran’s Revolutionary Guards, as responsible for the attacks. The French Foreign Ministry stated it would summon Iran’s ambassador and propose new European Union sanctions against the individuals and organisations involved. French prosecutors requested international arrest warrants for several members of the Shahid Kaveh group. France’s cybersecurity agency ANSSI stated that hackers raised refrigeration settings during the night of 11–12 October. French authorities estimated that the resulting food losses amounted to tens of millions of euros after at least 15 fires broke out. A November wave of refrigeration incidents also affected French blood banks, forcing staff to move medical supplies into other cold storage.

stories.headline: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
stories.text: Nvidia chief executive officer Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair in a letter to company employees and a press release. United States officials suspect that Megaspeed executive Alice Huang is a Chinese spy who fed information to Beijing. Singapore-based AI infrastructure company Megaspeed purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over a two-year period. The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia’s board is preparing to oust Jensen Huang following the controversies. Nvidia shares dropped about 8% in after-hours trading on Wednesday and fell 11% over the preceding five days. Three Republican congressmen requested that Jensen Huang appear for a closed-door joint briefing for questioning. U.S. President Donald Trump stated he supports Jensen Huang and believes the chief executive should remain at Nvidia.

stories.headline: UK Regulator Gives Unilever and McCormick Until Nov. 18 to Fix Competition Concerns or Face Deeper Probe into $65 Billion Food Merger
stories.text: The Competition and Markets Authority gave Unilever and McCormick until November 18 to propose remedies for their $65 billion food merger or face a second-phase investigation. The initial review by the Competition and Markets Authority found the transaction could weaken competition in dry ingredient mixes and dry sauces supplied to UK retailers. McCormick shares dropped 2.1% in London trading, while Unilever shares remained little changed following the regulatory announcement. Unilever announced in March that it planned to combine its food operations with McCormick to create a company valued at approximately $65 billion. Federal Trade Commission records showed the transaction cleared a US regulatory hurdle on October 5 under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act. Unilever stated in August that it decided to put Colman's up for sale to get ahead of potential antitrust objections. The Competition and Markets Authority concluded that mustard is not a concern because English, French, and American-style mustards are distinct product markets.

stories.headline: Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi bring progress on prisoners but not on peace
stories.text: Russia and Ukraine agreed to the largest prisoner exchange of the war during US-brokered talks in Abu Dhabi. Donald Trump’s envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff led the two-day delegations to find a solution for the nearly-five-year war. David Arakhamia stated that there was big progress on security guarantees for Ukraine and good momentum before the new year. Jared Kushner stated the planned exchange is expected to involve more than 1,000 prisoners from each side. US envoys are scheduled to visit Vladimir Putin in Moscow on Thursday and Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin. Vladimir Medinsky stated that every inch of their land will be returned to Russia and peace must be on its terms. Russia launched drones at Kyiv and other regions while Ukraine struck the Ust-Luga port on Russia’s Baltic coast.

stories.headline: Despite the sanctions, China Telecom Europe does business with Russia
stories.text: China Telecom Europe plans to purchase more services in Russia and offset mutual debts to recover €3.8m in provisions for bad debts. China Telecom Europe filed its 2025 annual accounts on 21 October with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register. China Telecom Europe set aside a specific provision of £3.19m, equivalent to €3.81m, to cover amounts owed by Russian customers. China Telecom Europe's Russian exposure accounts for nearly 61% of the €6.28m set aside as a provision for all doubtful debts. Rostelecom is explicitly excluded from China Telecom Europe's provision of €3.81m as the only client in Russia identified in the accounting note. China Telecom Europe reported a turnover of €420.15m in 2025, representing a 33.6% increase year-on-year. China Telecom Europe's net profit more than doubled, rising from €3.15m to €6.89m.

stories.headline: Tata Steel targets 10 million tonnes of domestic iron ore sales this year as captive curbs ease
stories.text: Tata Steel targets selling 10 million tonnes of iron ore to the domestic market this fiscal year, up from about 2 million tonnes previously. Koushik Chatterjee stated that Tata Steel has iron ore production exceeding 48 million tonnes annually. Tata Steel is evaluating iron ore imports from Canada and Australia to handle high alumina content in Indian iron ore. Tata Steel targets annual cost savings of ₹5,000-10,000 crore in India through operational efficiencies and lower maintenance costs. Tata Steel's UK business Ebitda loss narrowed to £57 million in Q2FY27 from £66 million a year earlier. Tata Steel is replacing its blast furnaces with an electric arc furnace at Port Talbot under an agreement with the UK government.

stories.headline: Ukraine hit by ‘significant’ Starshield disruptions as US envoys meet Putin, Zelenskyy says - Europe live
stories.text: Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced on X that the Ukrainian army is facing major disruptions in Starshield operations across Ukraine. Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that the disruptions have persisted for several days across the entire frontline and temporarily occupied territories. Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported that systematic speed restrictions limit Starshield to 161 kilometers per hour or 100 miles per hour. Volodymyr Zelenskyy explained that investigations by the Ukrainian military confirmed these issues are systematic speed restrictions rather than random errors. Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that the disruption hinders the interception of Russian jet-powered drones and allows successful strikes. Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that the situation assists Russians in killing more Ukrainians and executing more accurate strikes.

stories.headline: Norwest's $4 billion fund to back India's manufacturing, healthcare, AI
stories.text: Norwest Venture Partners plans to deploy a significant part of its newly raised $4 billion fund into Indian opportunities. Niren Shah stated that Norwest Venture Partners will continue investing in India at a pace of $250-300 million a year. Following the latest fundraising, Norwest Venture Partners' total capital under management reached $18 billion. Norwest Venture Partners has recorded 30 exits from portfolio companies in India over the last two decades, including 10 initial public offerings. Companies such as Five Star Finance, Veritas and Everbrands have filed for initial public offerings. Four more companies, including Ofbusiness and Mintifi, are appointing bankers and expect to file for initial public offerings over the next six months.

stories.headline: China says US ‘fabricating’ Nvidia spy claims to justify tech ‘blockade’
stories.text: China urged the United States to halt fabricating spy narratives to justify a technological blockade. US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping previously agreed to ease tariffs and lift tech restrictions in Busan, South Korea. Megaspeed stated on Thursday that it takes compliance obligations under US export control laws extremely seriously. Donald Trump cleared Nvidia's H200 chips for export to China last year despite objections from lawmakers. China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs denied the allegations, calling them entirely groundless, speculative, and intended to smear China. Nvidia launched an investigation into Jensen Huang on Sunday, leaving his position at the $4.2 trillion company hanging in the balance.

stories.headline: Vivo X500 series India launch on November 26; 200MP camera tipped: Expected price and key specifications
stories.text: Vivo confirmed that the Vivo X500 smartphone series will launch in India on November 26, 2026, alongside the Vivo Watch GT2. Vivo announced three models in the lineup: the Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max. The Vivo X500 Pro Max features a 200 MP Samsung ISOCELL HP0 periscope telephoto camera and a 50 MP Sony LYTIA 910 primary sensor. Leaked pricing indicates that the entry-level Vivo X500 will begin at ₹ 119,999 for the 12GB RAM and 256GB storage configuration. Leaked pricing suggests the Vivo X500 Pro is tipped to cost ₹ 149,999, while the Vivo X500 Pro Max could start at ₹ 159,999. The 512GB Vivo X500 Pro Max variant may cost ₹ 179,999, and the Pro Max Master Set kit may cost up to ₹ 229,999.

stories.headline: BYD Denza D9 Teaser Released, Launching in India on November 13
stories.text: BYD luxury car brand Denza released a teaser for its first MPV, the D9, scheduled for launch in India on November 13. The Denza D9 is expected to launch alongside the Z9 GT performance car, marking the debut of the Denza brand in the Indian car market. Globally, the electric Denza D9 features a 103kWh BYD Blade battery offering a range of up to 520 km on a single charge under the WLTP cycle. The front-wheel-drive version of the global Denza D9 delivers 313 bhp of power and 360 Nm of torque. The all-wheel-drive version of the global Denza D9 generates 374 bhp of power and 470 Nm of torque. The MG M9 has a starting ex-showroom price of ₹79.94 lakhs, serving as a competitor to the Denza D9.

stories.headline: Volkswagen China EV Sales Jump 350% in October to Record High
stories.text: Volkswagen recorded more than 28,000 sales of new energy vehicles in China in October 2026, which is an increase of nearly 350% compared to a year earlier. The monthly sales record for Volkswagen was supported by newly introduced models like the ID. Aura T6 SUV and the ID. Era 5S sedan. Volkswagen reported that its deliveries in China fell 38.5% in the third quarter compared to the same period in the previous year, while deliveries over the first nine months of 2026 declined 30.2%. Fully electric vehicles accounted for only 3.5% of Volkswagen's sales in China during the first nine months of 2026, and its Chinese joint operations slipped into losses. Data from the China Passenger Car Association showed that passenger new-energy vehicle retail sales reached 1.109 million units in October, down 13.7% from October 2025. Total passenger-car retail sales in China stood at 1.643 million units in October, marking a 27.1% year-on-year decline.

stories.headline: Castrol open offer: Investor group challenges interpretation of takeover rules behind Rs 11.5 price cut
stories.text: The Small Investors' Welfare Association approached the Securities and Exchange Board of India to challenge the deduction of Rs 11.50 per share from the Castrol India open-offer price. Motion JVCo made an open offer to acquire an additional 26 percent stake in Castrol India. The open-offer price for Castrol India was initially fixed at Rs 194.04 per share in December 2025 and enhanced by Rs 16.91 under a 10% annual increase provision. The Small Investors' Welfare Association sought the restoration of the Castrol India offer price to Rs 210.95 from Rs 199.45. Motion JVCo clubbed a final dividend of Rs 5.25 and an interim dividend of Rs 6.25 per share from Castrol India. The Small Investors' Welfare Association asked the Securities and Exchange Board of India to examine Regulation 8(9) interpretation, seek explanations from Motion JVCo and its manager UBS Securities India, and require corrective disclosures.

stories.headline: IPO listing: This robotics firm's shares jump 83% in exchange debut; 3 Indian stocks to watch | Returns, other details
stories.text: Chinese robotics platform Amicro Technology raised HK$1.78 billion through its initial public offering. Amicro Technology shares rallied as much as 82.9% to reach an intraday high of HK$18.11 on Thursday. Amicro Technology priced its 71.7 million shares at HK$9.9 apiece for the IPO. Memory product maker Hoisin Electronics Co. began trading at HK 72.80 on its market debut. Affordable Robotic & Automation shares traded 4.98% higher at ₹227.55 per share on the BSE at 3 pm on Thursday. Carver Roboweld share price rallied nearly 5% to touch an all-time high of ₹105.26 per share on the BSE on Thursday.

stories.headline: Australia vs England ODI 2026: Know where to watch live streaming and telecast in India
stories.text: Fast bowler Jofra Archer returns to the England ODI setup after being rested for a tri-series against Pakistan and Sri Lanka. Jofra Archer took 3/34 in eight overs in a warm-up match where England defeated Western Australia by 92 runs in Perth. Harry Brook will captain the England squad for the series. Mitchell Marsh will captain the Australia squad, which has rested Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, and Josh Hazlewood. The second ODI will be held in Adelaide on Sunday, followed by the final match in Hobart on Wednesday. Live streaming for the ODI series in India will be available on FanCode.

stories.headline: Nifty target at 26,200 as BofA tweaks India strategy; upgrades hospitals, telecom, downgrades two-wheelers
stories.text: Bank of America Securities retained its year-end Nifty target at 26,200, which indicates a potential upside of 4.7% from current levels. Bank of America Securities highlighted that earnings growth for the Nifty picked up to between 13% and 18% in the first half of FY27 compared to 5% in Q4 FY26. Bank of America Securities stated that the Nifty is currently trading at approximately 18.3 times earnings, which is close to its long-term average. Bank of America Securities noted that historically in 50 El Niño years, rainfall was 15% below average in 11 of those years. Bank of America Securities warned that salary and pension increases related to the Eighth Pay Commission could add about 60 basis points of GDP to government expenditure in FY28. Bank of America Securities downgraded its view on two-wheeler stocks while upgrading hospitals and telecom as part of its sectoral strategy changes.

stories.headline: Fertiliser use in India needs a rethink, says Deepak Fertilisers CMD SC Mehta
stories.text: Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd CMD SC Mehta stated at the Kisan Tak Bharat Agriculture Conference that India must rethink its fertiliser usage because excessive application harms soil health, crop quality, and farmers' incomes. SC Mehta stated that plants absorb only a small share of applied urea and DAP, while the remaining fertiliser seeps into water sources and harms the environment. SC Mehta pointed out that Indian wheat yields are considerably lower compared to those achieved by China. SC Mehta suggested that government fertiliser subsidies should be transferred directly to farmers instead of using the existing routing system. Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd developed crop-specific fertilisers in Maharashtra by combining primary nutrients with micronutrients and biostimulants. SC Mehta reported that the company's crop-specific formulations for sugarcane, cotton, and onions improved crop yields and quality, including better sugar content in sugarcane, fibre quality in cotton, and size and shelf life in onions.

stories.headline: Power shortages push discoms to costly bilateral deals
stories.text: Electricity prices in the bilateral market touched ₹ 30 per unit this summer and reached as high as ₹ 41.50 per unit for coming months. Spot rates on power exchanges are capped at ₹ 10 per unit, and at ₹ 20 per unit in the high-price day-ahead market. Peak electricity demand reached a record 270.8 gigawatts, and daily power deficits crossed 30 million units in September. Lokesh Chandra, chairman and managing director of Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd, stated that El Niño and economic growth drove up demand. The Indian Energy Exchange recorded a monthly electricity traded volume of 13.1 billion units in October, marking a 16.5% year-on-year increase. India's overall energy consumption reached 159.8 billion units in October, which is up 21.9% year-on-year.

stories.headline: AIT Worldwide Logistics Expands into Oceania with Acquisition of Australia-Based Connor Anderson International
stories.text: AIT Worldwide Logistics agreed to acquire Sydney-based Connor Anderson International to expand its presence in Australia and the Oceania region. Connor Anderson International was founded in 1974 and offers sea, air, and road freight transportation, customs brokerage, warehousing, and project cargo management. Connor Anderson International operates offices and warehouse facilities in Sydney and Melbourne. Ray Fennelly, Chief Development Officer at AIT Worldwide Logistics, stated that the two companies have maintained a business relationship since 2011. Theo Pambris, Director at Connor Anderson International, stated that the company has put customers first for more than 50 years. The financial terms of the acquisition transaction were not disclosed by the companies.

stories.headline: Cambodia, France Space, defence, energy and airports: the French agreements to be signed with Cambodia during Macron visit
stories.text: Cambodian officials are preparing defence plans for a potential new escalation in fighting despite the border conflict with Thailand being frozen for a year. Military intelligence from Kyiv is tracking Russian instructors from the Rubicon unit distributing Geran kamikaze drone user manuals in Phnom Penh and Pyongyang. The Russian embassy in Phnom Penh aims to strengthen bilateral military cooperation with an emphasis on maritime access following the Kazan summit. Officials from Cambodia and Thailand are visiting Paris to consult French government archive maps amid ongoing border tensions and legal wrangling. Sar Sokha has retained two law firms to prevent sanctions as Washington cracks down on Chinese organised crime. The new international airport in Cambodia is the focus of a power struggle involving a cancelled security contract, low numbers, controversial Chinese equipment, and US visits.

stories.headline: Wheelock Place renamed Landmark Orchard after $1.1 billion acquisition by Hongkong Land
stories.text: Wheelock Place on Orchard Road was renamed Landmark Orchard following its acquisition by Hongkong Land. The renaming became effective on Nov 12, three months after the acquisition by Hongkong Land's Singapore Central Private Real Estate Fund. The 21-storey building has existed in Orchard Road for over 30 years and includes offices, shops, and a direct link to Orchard MRT station. Hongkong Land stated that it plans to make improvements to Landmark Orchard without disclosing further details. Foo Pei Teng, chief executive of the Singapore fund, stated that the group will apply its long-term investment approach to Landmark Orchard. The Singapore Central Private Real Estate Fund targets about $15 billion in assets under management.

stories.headline: Trump’s $10bn BBC battle goes ahead - The Latest
stories.text: Donald Trump filed a $10bn defamation lawsuit against the BBC. A Trump-appointed Florida judge threw out the BBC's attempt to get the lawsuit dismissed. The legal case was granted permission to proceed following the dismissal attempt. The lawsuit focuses on an edit in a 2024 Panorama documentary. The documentary spliced two comments together made by Donald Trump during a rally before the January 6 Capitol riots. The BBC has previously apologised for the edit in the Panorama documentary.

stories.headline: ITV to cut show budgets as UK TV and film production spend drops by more than £2bn
stories.text: ITV plans to make £30m in temporary savings, consisting of £25m in content and £5m elsewhere in the business. ITV expects its advertising revenues to fall between 5% and 10% in the final quarter of the year. The British Film Institute reported that UK spending on film and high-end TV shows plunged by £2.08bn year on year. Total spending by domestic and international broadcasters, Hollywood studios and streamers reached £5.2bn in the year to the end of September. Shares in ITV dropped almost 4% in trading on Wednesday. Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy issued a public interest intervention notice, triggering an investigation into the £1.6bn sale of ITV's TV and streaming business to Sky.

stories.headline: Zelenskyy warns Ukraine is 'not real estate' as experts say a Russia peace deal remains elusive
stories.text: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that his country is not real estate during the final day of U.S.-brokered peace talks. Volodymyr Zelenskyy spoke to reporters in Denmark on Tuesday regarding peace talks in Abu Dhabi between Russian and Ukrainian representatives. U.S. envoy Jared Kushner described the trilateral peace talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the U.S. as productive. Vladimir Medinsky, Russia chief negotiator and Putin aide, announced that an agreement on a large-scale prisoner exchange was reached on Wednesday. Mykola Bielieskov, a senior analyst at Ukrainian NGO Come Back Alive, stated that Ukraine might accept a ceasefire along current front lines. William Courtney, former U.S. ambassador, stated that the Trump administration is no longer attempting to achieve a ceasefire due to Russian objections.

stories.headline: Concurrent (LSE:CNC) Wins US Defence Work Beyond FTSE 100
stories.text: Concurrent Technologies Plc secured a new US defence design contract to further its expansion into the American defence market. Concurrent Technologies Plc designs single board computers and rugged systems for military vehicles, radar, communications, and demanding environments. Design contracts enable Concurrent Technologies Plc to secure early placement in a programme ahead of potential larger production orders. Concurrent Technologies Plc develops tailored computing solutions to meet customer exact specifications under these design contracts. The latest US contract follows previous American wins including an agreement with a major global US prime contractor and another defence contract from the prior year. Defence has become the most important growth driver for Concurrent Technologies Plc as Western governments increase spending on modernisation.

stories.headline: This Trader Raised Alarm About Nvidia’s China Entanglements Months Ago
stories.text: On May 13, stock researcher and trader Christian Lamarco published a 40-page report questioning Nvidia's business behavior. Christian Lamarco included a warning regarding the relationship between Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang and Megaspeed employee Alice Huang. Christian Lamarco used paid expert networks to speak with current and former employees of Megaspeed and Nvidia. Nvidia shares increased in price on the day Christian Lamarco published his report online in May. Jensen Huang confessed to an extramarital affair with Alice Huang after previously denying it. United States intelligence accused Alice Huang of being a Chinese spy.

stories.headline: How Earnings Low Point Will Impact Mosaic Stock
stories.text: Mosaic reported sales of US$3,100.6 million for the third quarter of 2026. Mosaic posted a net loss of US$72.1 million for the third quarter of 2026. Mosaic recorded a net loss of US$602.5 million over the first nine months. Mosaic's diluted earnings per share swung to a loss of US$0.23 compared to the prior year. Mosaic's narrative projects US$13.1b in revenue and US$674.0 million in earnings by the year 2029. Brink's provided a fourth quarter 2026 revenue outlook ranging between US$1,365 million and US$1,415 million. Brink's narrative projects reaching US$6.2b in revenue and US$664.6 million in earnings by 2029. The 2029 projection relies on analysts assuming an annual revenue growth rate of 4.1%. Brink's earnings are projected to increase by roughly US$483 million from a baseline of US$181.2 million.

stories.headline: India's Next Billion-Dollar IPO? Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields in line after Jio, NSE - key things to know
stories.text: Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields is preparing for an initial public offering that could raise up to $1 billion. The Securities and Exchange Board of India issued observations on Mahanadi Coalfields' draft offer documents on November 4. The Mahanadi Coalfields public offering will be an offer for sale with Coal India selling a 10% stake in its subsidiary. Mahanadi Coalfields' net profit declined by approximately 2% year on year to ₹2,398.7 crore in the June quarter of FY27.

stories.headline: U.S. CPI Fuels Talk of Half-Point Fed Hike as Treasury Yields Spike
stories.text: CoreWeave saw its debt increase to $46.9 billion from $35.1 billion. All eight domestically listed KOSPI 200 covered-call exchange-traded funds reduced their October payouts with an average decline of 15.3%. Korean retail investors shifted more than 95% of their Tesla-related funds into SpaceX. Anthropic is scheduled to list on Nasdaq on the 19th.

stories.headline: Gold Price Declines Surge European & American Investors' Demand for Gold ETFs
stories.text: According to the World Gold Council report released on November 3, net capital inflows into global Gold ETFs in the third quarter reached 31 billion U.S. dollars. In the third quarter, gold holdings of Gold ETFs increased by 211 tons quarter-on-quarter, bringing total holdings to 4,256 tons.

stories.headline: Nigeria’s October crude output averages 1.69 million bpd, meeting OPEC quota for sixth month
stories.text: Nigeria's crude oil output averaged 1.69 million barrels per day in October according to upstream regulator data released on Wednesday. Nigeria's crude oil production peaked at 1.79 million barrels per day during October.

stories.headline: Natural Gas Price Forecast: December NG Breaks $3.24 Toward $3.60 on Record LNG Flows
stories.text: Average flows to the nine major US export terminals reached 19.3 Bcf/d in November, surpassing October's average monthly record of 18.4 Bcf/d. Total inventories stand at 3,801 Bcf, which is 109 Bcf or 2.8% below the 3,910 Bcf held a year earlier, and 55 Bcf or 1.4% above the five-year average of 3,747 Bcf.

stories.headline: Brent Jumps Nearly 3% as Iran Denies Any Talks With Washington
stories.text: Brent crude rose nearly 3% on Wednesday to $93.90 per barrel at 11:18 a.m. ET, while WTI rose nearly 2% to $87.98. A Ukrainian drone strike set off a fire at Russia’s Ust-Luga export hub, and Ukrainian attacks have disrupted about 30% of Russia’s refining capacity since late October.

stories.headline: JSW Dulux navigates volatile crude oil, cost pressures to drive volume growth
stories.text: JSW Dulux plans to aggressively pursue market expansion strategies following resilient double-digit volume growth achieved despite macroeconomic headwinds, geopolitical volatility, and crude oil price fluctuations. Managing Director and CEO Rajiv Rajgopal stated that JSW Dulux maintained its growth despite input cost spikes from international developments, including a recent 2 per cent anti-dumping duty on few chemicals.

stories.headline: Burberry returns to profit as sales soar, from £85 socks to £9,000 bags
stories.text: Burberry reported a pre-tax profit of £19m in the six months to 26 September compared to a loss of £48m a year previously. Burberry achieved a sales growth of 6% with total sales rising to £1.1bn over the period. Burberry sales increased by 15% in China and 14% in the Americas during the six-month period. Burberry sales decreased by 1% in the Europe and Middle East region, which was partly attributed to the Iran war. Burberry chief executive Joshua Schulman stated that the brand implemented a pyramid of pricing ranging from £85 socks to leather versions costing more than £9,000.

stories.headline: New business-class seats, Air India plans among key takeaways from SIA’s first-half results briefing
stories.text: Singapore Airlines reported a 43.9% lower net profit for the first half of the financial year due to higher jet fuel prices. Singapore Airlines posted $5.6 billion in revenue, representing a 14.3% year-on-year increase for the second quarter ended Sept 30. Singapore Airlines reported that net profit for the second quarter quadrupled to $209.7 million. Singapore Airlines shares closed on November 12 at $7.25, gaining more than 1%. Singapore Airlines holds a 25.1% stake in Air India and recorded a $361.7 million share of the carrier’s losses.

stories.headline: Ireland's McEntee on Ukraine, Defense, UK-EU Relations
stories.text: Irish Foreign Minister Helen McEntee spoke with Bloomberg's Oliver Crook in Dublin during a meeting of the European Political Community. Helen McEntee discussed efforts to end the conflict between Russia and Ukraine. Helen McEntee stated that it is absolutely essential for Europe to be included in negotiations to end the conflict. Helen McEntee talked about recent bomb threats across the continent. Helen McEntee discussed the relationship between the European Union and the UK.

stories.headline: India’s Registration Committee Clears 14 New Pesticide Products
stories.text: India’s Registration Committee approved 14 new crop protection and household pest control products at its 477th meeting. Willowood Industries received approval to manufacture fluxametamide technical with a minimum 93.70% purity in India instead of importing it. Coromandel International secured approval for a three-way wettable powder combining bispyribac sodium 2%, penoxsulam 2% and 2,4-D sodium salt 50% for transplanted paddy rice. Godrej Consumer Products won registration for a renofluthrin 0.75% household product targeting three mosquito species. Tropical Agrosystem (India) received approval to import 1-methylcyclopropene 2% tablets for post-harvest treatment of apples from AgroFresh Inc. in Philadelphia.

stories.headline: Taking Stock: Sensex, Nifty end flat amid volatility; realty shines, IT, auto drag
stories.text: The total market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies increased by Rs 1.57 lakh crore to reach Rs 512.29 lakh crore compared to the previous session. Taj GVK shares dropped 6 percent after reporting a 24 percent fall in second-quarter profit. Nava shares gained 5 percent following strong second-quarter numbers. Adani Enterprises share price rose 1 percent following a Memorandum of Understanding with Corporación Nacional del Cobre de Chile. Lemon Tree Hotels shares increased by 4.6 percent after CLSA maintained an Outperform rating.

stories.headline: From the UK to the Gulf, are US overseas bases becoming liabilities?
stories.text: In October, the United States removed all 12 of its B-1 Lancer bombers from RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire due to safety concerns regarding a growing Iranian threat. British security forces arrested several individuals after the British government accused Iran of orchestrating a plot to target RAF Fairford, an allegation denied by Tehran. In July, the United States relocated numerous military assets from Gulf bases severely damaged during the war with Iran to Jordan while considering a move to Israel. At the Prince Sultan airbase in Saudi Arabia, at least five KC-135 aerial refuelling tankers and at least one airborne early-warning and control aircraft were damaged in strikes. US President Donald Trump stated on Monday that further military action against Iran was unnecessary for the present, though the US naval blockade remains active.

stories.headline: Eli Lilly becomes first drugmaker to have a GLP-1 weight loss pill approved in China
stories.text: Eli Lilly gained approval in China on Thursday for orforglipron, making it the first drugmaker to secure approval for a GLP-1 weight-loss pill in the country. The newly approved pill orforglipron will compete in China against injections from Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk, Pfizer, and Innovent Biologics. Novo Nordisk has submitted an application to sell the oral version of Wegovy in China. China's National Health Commission stated that the proportion of overweight or obese individuals in China could exceed 65% by 2030, compared to approximately 50% in 2020. J.P. Morgan's head of China healthcare research, Yang Huang, forecasts that annual sales of GLP-1 weight management therapies in China could reach 30 billion yuan within the next five to seven years.

stories.headline: US envoys arrive in Moscow for Russia-Ukraine talks with Putin
stories.text: United States envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff arrived in Moscow for discussions with Russian President Vladimir Putin concerning the war in Ukraine. Trilateral peace talks concluded in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday with an upcoming prisoner exchange planned, though no final resolution was reached. French Minister Delegate for European Affairs Benjamin Haddad announced that the European Union will approve new sanctions targeting 150 additional entities and 50 banks on Monday. Deputy Energy Minister Artem Nekrasov stated that overnight Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure led to power outages across nine regions. Ukraine's military reported that five of Russia's largest oil refineries, including Omsk and Kirishi, were struck by Ukraine since October 30.

stories.headline: India’s FTAs to open access to $85 trillion of global economy: Piyush Goyal
stories.text: Piyush Goyal stated that India's Free Trade Agreements provide open market access to $85 trillion of the global economy. Union Minister Piyush Goyal spoke at the inaugural session of the 31st CII Partnership Summit on Wednesday. Piyush Goyal noted that India has signed nine Free Trade Agreements providing open market access in 38 countries. Piyush Goyal stated that India is the safest destination for global investments in a turbulent world. Piyush Goyal identified open markets, respect for intellectual property rights, and reliability as the three major offerings for investors in India.

stories.headline: How BEML plans to gain an edge over China in building India's tunnel-boring machines | Decoded
stories.text: BEML Ltd plans to develop indigenous tunnel-boring machines to reduce India's import dependence, starting with smaller equipment for metro rail, hydropower, irrigation, and water projects. BEML Ltd will initially focus on tunnel-boring machines with diameters ranging from 3.5 metres to 6.5 metres for urban transit and utility projects. BEML Chairman and Managing Director Shantanu Roy stated that the company intends to build proprietary technology with intellectual property remaining in India and bring on board a global consultant. Shantanu Roy estimates that India's tunnel-boring machine market could grow by around 12% annually over the next seven to eight years. BEML Ltd estimates that it would require around 22 months to deliver its first tunnel-boring machine after securing a contract.

stories.headline: Monsoon’s first large-scale onset occurs over Northeast India, suggests IIT-Madras, Gauhati University study
stories.text: Researchers from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras and Gauhati University published a study in the Journal of Climate last month indicating the Indian monsoon system first forms over Northeast India around May 15. The study analyzed 84 years of daily rainfall data spanning from 1940 to 2023 utilizing a climate-network approach. Around June 9, the Northeast and peninsular rainfall clusters merge over the peninsula to establish the large-scale monsoon system. The large-scale rainy season in Northeast India and the southwestern peninsula is estimated by the study to be 20-30 days shorter than the locally defined rainy season. Applying the method to the 2026 southwest monsoon, researchers identified June 22 as the date of large-scale onset over the Indian peninsula.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang's affair with alleged spy revives push to tighten China chip curbs ahead of Trump-Xi summit
stories.text: A scandal involving Nvidia Corp CEO Jensen Huang is helping U.S. lawmakers push for tighter restrictions on China's access to advanced artificial intelligence chips ahead of a planned meeting between President Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. Short seller firm Culper Research estimated in May that more than 20% of Nvidia Corp's revenue for the year ended July 2025, or approximately $43.2 billion, came from China through illegal GPU diversion and Southeast Asian intermediaries.
