Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer called on Congress on Tuesday to pass chip restriction bills and demanded a full accounting of President Donald Trump's defense of Nvidia Corp CEO Jensen Huang. President Donald Trump is expected to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping on November 18-19 during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation leaders' summit in Shenzhen. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated on Tuesday that he intends to travel to China for the summit next week and build a constructive relationship based on balance and reciprocity.

stories.headline: Financial stocks hold Nifty steady at midday; Auto, FMCG drag
stories.text: Indian benchmark indices traded nearly flat at midday on Thursday, with the BSE Sensex at 81,930.41 and the NSE Nifty 50 at 25,255.55 as of 12.50 pm. HDFC Life Insurance surged 3.91 per cent to ₹596.00 to become the top gainer on the Nifty 50. Mahindra & Mahindra fell 2.51 per cent to ₹3,378.00 as the biggest drag on the losing side. MCX crude oil fell sharply to trade near ₹8,050 per barrel, down about 1.6 per cent. MCX December gold traded near ₹1,39,230 per 10 grams, down about 0.3 per cent.

stories.headline: China’s central bank signals easing restraint as growth holds up
stories.text: Analysts at Citic Securities noted that rate cuts are not expected on the near-term horizon based on the latest quarterly report from the People’s Bank of China. The People’s Bank of China stated its commitment to maintain a pro-growth, accommodative policy stance while expressing concern about the risk of too-low rates. Citic Securities analysts stated that the current round of policy easing has likely run its course. Citigroup economists stated that loan rates and mortgage rates in China are currently around 3%. CICC analysts expect the central bank to lower financing costs through reforms like market-based interest rate overhauls and structural tools rather than broad-based rate cuts.

stories.headline: India, Canada discuss advancing CEPA talks to boost trade and investment ties
stories.text: India and Canada discussed advancing negotiations for a proposed free trade agreement on Wednesday. The discussions took place between Indian Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal and Canadian Minister of International Trade Maninder Sidhu. Maninder Sidhu led a Canadian delegation during the visit to India. The two countries focused on advancing negotiations regarding the India-Canada Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. Piyush Goyal stated that the discussions aimed to strengthen bilateral economic ties.

stories.headline: Singapore Airlines’ Air India bet takes a beating as profitability remains elusive
stories.text: Singapore Airlines reduced the carrying value of its investment in Air India to S$799.9 million as of September. Air India is estimated to have recorded a loss of Rs 10,800 crore in the first half of FY27. Air India reported a net loss of Rs 22,238 crore in FY26, which was more than double the loss recorded in the previous year. Air India reported negative operating cash flow of Rs 1,790 crore in FY26. Air India CEO and managing director Tewolde Gebremariam stated in early November that the transformation could take another 15 to 20 years.

stories.headline: As Beijing pushes for cash return, Chinese firms can unlock 15% valuation boost: report
stories.text: Goldman Sachs stated that Chinese companies could increase equity valuation upside by 15 per cent through share buy-backs and dividend payouts. Goldman Sachs reported that Beijing is encouraging listed firms to return more cash to investors. The US investment bank released a report on Wednesday detailing the potential valuation boost. The proposed increase in corporate payout ratios and share repurchases aligns with policymakers’ efforts to improve shareholder returns. The potential valuation increase of about 15 per cent applies to the MSCI China Index.

stories.headline: ISRAELIRANWAR. Iran: Nuclear power will remain. We are capable of striking even very distant bases, a warning to European countries. USA: Let's entrust Iraq with mediating with Iran. IRGC strikes Didamar Island.
stories.text: The United States House of Representatives voted 211-204 to refer an impeachment resolution against Secretary of War Hegseth to the House Judiciary Committee. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent left his home for a military base following threats from Iran according to sources cited by the New York Times. Mohsen Rezaei stated that Tehran has no intention of exporting its enriched uranium and will use it for nuclear-powered ships and submarines. The Gaza Ministry of Health announced that 1,622 Palestinians have been killed and 5,878 injured by Israeli attacks since the October 11, 2025 ceasefire. The Saudi-led coalition stated it intercepted three Yemeni cruise missiles in the skies above Riyadh.

stories.headline: New aviation deals raise flight limits between China and Central Asia
stories.text: China and Uzbekistan agreed to raise the weekly flight limit between the two countries from 100 to 114. Kazakhstan and China agreed to increase permitted weekly frequencies from 150 to 180 and added Chengdu and Kashgar as authorised destinations. The limit on other routes between Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan will increase from 14 to 20 flights a week. Vietjet Qazaqstan launched direct flights from Astana to Bishkek and Samarkand in November 2025. Adilbek Umraliyev stated that rising fuel prices and airport charges are making regional flights more expensive to operate.

stories.headline: India’s Inflation Rises, Keeping Rate-Hike Pressure on RBI
stories.text: India’s inflation accelerated to its highest level in two years in October The inflation rate breached the top of the Reserve Bank’s 2%-6% tolerance band The rise in inflation is adding pressure on policymakers to raise interest rates further

stories.headline: India bonds to stay hemmed in by oil, Treasury moves ahead of inflation data
stories.text: Indian government bonds are expected to trade between softer oil prices and rising US yields. The market is awaiting domestic inflation data that could influence the Reserve Bank of India's rate strategy. Investors remain cautious ahead of a significant bond auction scheduled for Friday.

stories.headline: Japan Producer Prices Pick Up, Backing Case for Another BOJ Hike
stories.text: Japan corporate goods inflation accelerated for the first time in three months according to the report. The acceleration in Japan corporate goods inflation adds to evidence of persistent price pressures. Persistent price pressures support the case for a Bank of Japan interest-rate increase next month.

stories.headline: The Fed Has to Raise Rates. How Fast to Go Has Officials Divided.
stories.text: Federal Reserve officials generally agree that interest rates must increase to control inflation. Inflation has exceeded the 2 percent target level for nearly six years. The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported on Tuesday that October price pressures broadened out faster than expected.

stories.headline: The Case For India in a World Obsessed With the AI Trade
stories.text: Srini Sriniwasan is the managing director at Kotak Alternate Asset Managers according to Bloomberg.

stories.headline: Does MGX's (ASX:MGX) Groundrush Decline Seal Its Gold Shift?
stories.text: MGX reported last month that the exit from the Koolan Island operation was progressing towards completion.

stories.headline: Russian crude oil prices jump on China, India demand
stories.text: Russian crude oil is trading at unusually high prices and its premium over international benchmark Brent has risen to a record high, according to Tokyo reports.

stories.headline: AI helps UK economy grow at fastest pace for more than two years
stories.text: The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the third quarter, which is its fastest expansion in two and a half years. The Office for National Statistics reported that the economy expanded by 0.2% in September. The UK information and communication sector grew by 2.1% in the third quarter of 2026. Policymakers at the Bank of England voted to raise interest rates by a quarter of a percentage point to 4%. Higher motor fuel prices in the UK have pushed the cost of petrol above £1.70 a litre. Diesel prices in the UK have moved towards an average of £2 a litre. The Office for National Statistics stated that wholesale electricity prices were about double the level of a year ago.

stories.headline: UK economy expands 0.7% in third quarter as AI provides 'extra engine of growth'
stories.text: The United Kingdom economy expanded by 0.7% in the third quarter, matching Reuters poll estimates. Gross domestic product grew 1.9% year-on-year in the three months leading up to September. The services sector expanded by 0.9%, offsetting production sector output growth of 0.1% and a 0.7% construction contraction. The information and communication sub-sector grew by 2.1% in the quarter, driven by artificial intelligence and cloud computing activities. The British pound fell by 0.2% against the United States dollar on Thursday morning. The United Kingdom annual inflation rate climbed to 3.5% in September. Financial markets are pricing in a 73% probability of a rate hike from the Bank of England in December according to LSEG data.

stories.headline: European tech shares fall as Nvidia board weighs ousting Jensen Huang
stories.text: European chip stocks fell on Thursday after Nvidia shares dropped 8.6% in after-hours trading on Wednesday following a report that Nvidia board members were preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang. ASML shares decreased 1.9% at 11:26 CET, while ASM International and STMicroelectronics shares both dropped less than 0.3% in late-morning trading. Germany’s DAX index increased more than 1% to 27,001 in morning trading, marking the first time it crossed the 27,000 level. Industrial group Siemens shares rose more than 4% following the reporting of record profits driven by data centre demand. Quilter Cheviot head of technology research Ben Barringer stated that the Nvidia board is taking allegations very seriously by hiring an external search firm to find potential successors for CEO Jensen Huang. Benchmark US crude oil prices decreased more than 0.7% to $85.87 a barrel, and Brent crude prices fell nearly 0.8% to $92 a barrel. Gold futures declined more than 1% with the continuous contract trading near $3,956 an ounce during late-morning European trading.

stories.headline: UK shares science expertise to enable ASEAN to deliver its AI and climate goals
stories.text: The UK ambassador to ASEAN is Her Excellency Helen Fazey. The ASEAN's Guide for Sustainable Data Centre Development calls for digital expansion to be balanced with environmental sustainability and resource security. The UK's Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office commissioned the AI for Sustainable Development in ASEAN study. SustFridge is an FCDO-funded initiative that develops solar-powered refrigerators for communities with limited access to electricity. The SustFridge collaboration has formed local partnerships with rural clinics and communities in Malaysia. The ASEAN-UK Plan of Action 2027-2031 sets out shared ambitions to strengthen responsible AI governance, technical capability, and AI for development.

stories.headline: Could the Voter Backlash Against A.I. Actually Help the Economy?
stories.text: The artificial intelligence boom supported the United States economy despite tariffs, war, and uncertainty. Voters in the midterm elections expressed dissatisfaction with the economic trade-offs of the artificial intelligence boom. Voters supported ballot initiatives and elected officials aiming to limit data center development. Economists suggest that decelerating the artificial intelligence expansion could enhance its long-term sustainability despite potential short-term difficulties. Newly elected Texas Democratic Governor Gina Hinojosa stated a desire for data center projects to benefit local communities rather than stopping them completely. Financial markets experienced volatility following the 2026 election due to the prospect of increased government oversight.

stories.headline: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate spying claims; UK chancellor ‘dismayed’ by budget leak – as it happened
stories.text: Nvidia has lost approximately $430 billion in market value following a recent spying scandal. Nvidia retained Joon H. Kim and the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to investigate chief executive Jensen Huang. The investigation will examine the relationship between Jensen Huang and Alice Huang, a former employee of Nvidia customer Megaspeed whom US officials suspect of being a Chinese spy. Beijing has denied allegations that it operated an espionage operation targeting Jensen Huang. Nvidia shares dropped by almost 5.5% yesterday after falling 4.27% on Monday. Nvidia market valuation decreased to $4.07 trillion from $4.50 trillion prior to the story breaking last weekend.

stories.headline: eClerx acquires RegEdge to bolster regulatory and compliance capabilities
stories.text: RegEdge is a US-based risk and regulatory consulting company founded in 2019. Kapil Jain stated that the deal is part of a strategy to expand capabilities through targeted acquisitions. Harshad Pitkar stated that joining eClerx allows the firm to extend its proprietary solutions to a larger client base. eClerx operates across 17 countries with over 23,300 employees.

stories.headline: Why more than half of India's fertiliser never feeds the crop, and how to fix it
stories.text: Mahesh Girdhar stated at the Kisan Tak Bharat Agriculture Conference in Delhi that nitrogen nutrient use efficiency is 30 to 45 per cent. Mahesh Girdhar stated that phosphorus nutrient use efficiency is 15 to 25 per cent and potash is about 50 per cent. Dr Sudhanshu Singh stated that rice in eastern Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Bengal manages about 30 per cent nitrogen efficiency. Dr Sudhanshu Singh stated that placing urea briquettes near the roots could raise nitrogen efficiency towards 70 per cent.

stories.headline: UK drone maker founded by Ukrainians hits £4.5bn value after raising £500m
stories.text: London-based naval drone maker UForce reached a valuation of £4.5bn after raising more than £500m from investors. The UK national wealth fund invested £113m in UForce as part of the funding round. Oleg Rogynskyy stated that UForce wanted to make aggression unaffordable and the investment would allow the company to scale up production. The UK Ministry of Defence stated that more than 70% of the content of each UK-built UForce boat would come from British suppliers.

stories.headline: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
stories.text: An Israeli air strike on Nasser hospital in the southern Gaza Strip killed at least six people and injured about 20, according to the Hamas-run health ministry. The Israeli military stated that the strike targeted a Hamas commander and other fighters using the hospital as a headquarters. Nasser hospital previously suffered a double Israeli strike in August 2025 that caused the deaths of at least 20 people. The Gaza health ministry reported that total fatalities in Gaza have exceeded 74,650 since the conflict began on 7 October 2023.

stories.headline: US mid-term results unlikely to speed up India trade deal as tariff uncertainties persist
stories.text: The outcome of the US mid-term elections is unlikely to speed up the proposed India-US interim trade agreement because President Donald Trump retains executive powers to impose tariffs. India wants clarity from the ongoing US investigation under Section 301 on excess industrial capacity before finalising its tariff commitments to protect its exporters against competitors like Bangladesh, Vietnam and Cambodia. India wants safeguards in the proposed trade agreement against the Lindsey Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which allows the US President to impose tariffs of up to 100 per cent on the five largest buyers of Russian crude oil and natural gas. The US Supreme Court issued a February 20 ruling invalidating reciprocal tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, which altered the tariff landscape.

stories.headline: Alice Huang Resurfaces in Beijing Amid Nvidia Scandal
stories.text: Alice Huang returned to China and is located in Beijing according to Bloomberg reporting. Alice Huang is central to a scandal involving Nvidia chief executive officer Jensen Huang. Nvidia is currently investigating spying allegations regarding the matter. Beijing has denied the spying allegations under investigation by Nvidia.

stories.headline: Estonia wants Costa and Kallas to speak for Europe in Ukraine peace talks
stories.text: Estonia wants European Council President António Costa and European Union foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas to represent Europe in Russia-Ukraine negotiations. Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal stated that António Costa and Kaja Kallas are clearly accountable to European Union countries. The matter is scheduled to be discussed at an informal European Council summit in Dublin on Friday following a request from Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni. Jared Kushner stated that if Europe could identify one person to speak on its behalf, it would be a bigger achievement than getting Russians to include them in negotiations.

stories.headline: ASEAN Moves to Build Emergency Oil Reserves Amid Iran Supply Crisis
stories.text: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations agreed to establish a joint crude oil stockpiling scheme due to supply disruptions from the war in Iran. The stockpiling scheme will include storage locations situated in Indonesia and Thailand for ASEAN members to use during tight supply periods. The Philippines requested permission to purchase gasoline and diesel from the storage facilities in Indonesia and Thailand during supply emergencies. Indonesia initiated the joint ASEAN oil stockpiling proposal, which received strong backing from Japan due to Japan's heavy reliance on energy imports.

stories.headline: China's Ministry of State Security thrust into the spotlight by Nvidia CEO affair
stories.text: China established the Ministry of State Security in 1983 to manage risks from the country's new openness to foreigners. U.S. government intelligence believe the Ministry of State Security recruited businesswoman Alice Huang to gather information on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Jensen Huang admitted to an affair over the weekend, though it remains unclear if sensitive information was shared. CrowdStrike stated in June that Chinese entities accounted for over half of state-sponsored intrusions targeting technology companies in the 12 months through March 31.

stories.headline: Singapore Air backs Tewolde's Air India reset, but losses keep investors on edge
stories.text: Tewolde Gebremariam took charge of Air India in October following the departure of Campbell Wilson the previous month. Air India is shifting some Europe- and US-bound services from Delhi to Mumbai to reduce fuel burn caused by avoiding Pakistani airspace. Singapore Airlines chief executive Goh Choon Phong stated that the lower share of losses was primarily attributable to the reversal of previous provisions. Air India reported a consolidated net loss of ₹ 22,238 crore in fiscal year 2026, while revenue from operations declined by over 9% to around ₹ 71,000 crore.

stories.headline: LIC, Coforge, Adani Green, Meesho Enter MSCI Global Standard Index; India's Weight Rises To 13.1%
stories.text: Life Insurance Corporation of India, Coforge, Adani Green Energy and Meesho are added to the MSCI Global Standard Index in the November 2026 index review. India's weight in the MSCI Global Standard Index increases from 12.9 per cent to 13.1 per cent. All changes announced in the November 2026 review will be implemented at the close of November 30, 2026. Life Insurance Corporation of India ranks as one of the three largest additions to the MSCI Emerging Markets Index by full company market capitalisation.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang Salary: How much does the Nvidia CEO get paid? All about the base salary, bonus, stock, and other perks
stories.text: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang has an estimated net worth of $147 billion to $148 billion as of November 2026, ranking as the 12th wealthiest person on Forbes' Real-Time Billionaires list. According to Nvidia’s 2026 Proxy Statement, Jensen Huang's reported compensation for the year is $36.3 million, marking a 27% decrease from the previous year's $49.9 million. Nvidia’s fiscal 2027 compensation plan sets a target cash bonus of $4 million for Jensen Huang, tied to specific revenue goals for the year ending January 31, 2027. Jensen Huang owns 870,604,104 shares of Nvidia, representing 3.58% of the company as its largest individual shareholder.

stories.headline: Buy Kalyan Jewellers India: target of Rs 800: ICICI Securities
stories.text: ICICI Securities reported that Kalyan Jewellers India grew its revenue, EBITDA, and PAT by approximately 31 percent, 30 percent, and 64 percent year-on-year in Q2FY27. Gross margin for Kalyan Jewellers India contracted by 61 basis points year-on-year to 12.3 percent in Q2FY27. ICICI Securities increased the EPS estimates for Kalyan Jewellers India for FY27 and FY28 by 0.6 percent and 3.1 percent respectively. ICICI Securities reiterated a buy rating on Kalyan Jewellers India with a revised DCF-based target price of INR 800.

stories.headline: India’s consumer AI startups win VC backing, but retention remains the big test
stories.text: Venture capital investors are increasing funding for Indian consumer artificial intelligence startups targeting everyday tasks. Credit and personal finance app Oolka raised $14 million in a funding round led by Accel. Wellness platform SuperLiving secured $7 million in funding led by Lightspeed, alongside Kae Capital and All In Capital. India-linked artificial intelligence companies raised $1.91 billion across 103 rounds in 2026 through Nov. 5 according to Tracxn data.

stories.headline: What we know so far about Nvidia partner Megaspeed’s Asia footprint
stories.text: Singapore cloud computing firm Megaspeed International faces scrutiny regarding suspicions that it facilitated at least $7.5 billion in restricted Nvidia chip shipments to Chinese firms. Megaspeed reported that its assets surged to about $3 billion in 2024 from $33 million in 2023, while revenue rose to $294 million with a loss of about $20 million. Short seller Culper Research alleged in May that Megaspeed and its Malaysian subsidiary Speedmatrix were secretly financed by Alibaba. Malaysian subsidiary Speedmatrix purchased at least $4.8 billion worth of advanced AI equipment containing Nvidia chips between June 2024 and February 2026.

stories.headline: Hong Kong business leaders examine investment opportunities under city’s first Five-Year plan
stories.text: The South China Morning Post and the Hong Kong Investment Corporation co-organised a closed-door SCMP C-Suite roundtable event in Hong Kong. Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po attended the roundtable discussion as the guest of honour. Hong Kong Investment Corporation CEO Clara Chan participated in the roundtable discussion as a guest speaker. Participants at the discussion explored how the development strategy of Hong Kong aligns with the 15th Five-Year Plan of China.

stories.headline: Ukraine war briefing: Zelenskyy sees ‘window of opportunity’ for peace as US envoys to meet Putin
stories.text: Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated there is an opportunity to achieve a breakthrough in negotiations to end the war before 2027. US presidential envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met with Russian president Vladimir Putin in Moscow. Russia and Ukraine agreed to the largest prisoner exchange of the war during US-brokered talks in Abu Dhabi. Three people died and 11 were injured in a daytime Russian attack on a market in the Odesa region, local authorities said.

stories.headline: Coral India Finance and Housing (NSE:CORALFINAC) Posted Healthy Earnings But There Are Some Other Factors To Be Aware Of
stories.text: Coral India Finance and Housing Limited experienced a strong stock price following its earnings report. Coral India Finance and Housing Limited reported an increase in non-operating revenue from ₹42.6m to ₹56.5m over the last year. Coral India Finance and Housing Limited posted a 9.9% increase in earnings per share in the last year. Coral India Finance and Housing Limited is currently showing 4 warning signs in investment analysis.

stories.headline: Brazil Crop Protection Industry Splits Over Tariff Push
stories.text: Tecnomyl Brasil announced it will leave the National Union of the Plant Defense Products Industry starting next year due to disagreement over the tariff push. On November 6, the Ministry of Agriculture's thematic committee on farm input policy voted to advise Brazil's Foreign Trade Chamber against the tariff increase. Aenda asked Brazil's Foreign Trade Chamber to reduce the import tax on formulated insecticides sold in packaging up to 7.5 kilograms from 7.2 percent to zero. On November 10, Brazil's Foreign Trade Chamber Tariff Alteration Committee reviewed the competing tariff proposals.

stories.headline: American soldier arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia
stories.text: London's Metropolitan Police announced on Tuesday evening that a senior U.S. Army soldier was arrested in the U.K. on suspicion of spying for Russia. A senior NATO military official confirmed on Tuesday that the unnamed 41-year-old American service member was assigned to the Allied Rapid Reaction Corps. FBI Director Kash Patel stated in a Tuesday evening statement that the allegations against the U.S. serviceman were of the utmost concern. Sean Stinchon, the commanding general of U.S. Army Counterintelligence Command, noted that the alleged conduct serves as a sobering reminder of insider threats.

stories.headline: Entertainment 360 Acquires Brigade, a Management Firm Rich in Substackers
stories.text: The talent management company Entertainment 360 announced an acquisition of the management firm Brigade. Max Stein founded Brigade in 2015 and will join Entertainment 360 as a partner. Entertainment 360 and Brigade declined to disclose the financial value of the transaction. Max Stein informed his clients about the acquisition on Tuesday.

stories.headline: Lebanon Faces Economic ‘Catastrophe’ After War and Years of Mismanagement
stories.text: Abdelnaser Ossman has faced soaring costs and plunging profits at his grape farm in Lebanon's Bekaa Valley since the war between Israel and Hezbollah began in March. Abdelnaser Ossman stated that fuel and fertilizer prices doubled while labor costs quintupled, and his harvest fetch price dropped by half. The World Bank forecasts inflation to rise by more than 17 percent in Lebanon this year due to supply disruptions, higher shipping costs, and soaring fuel prices. The World Bank predicts that Lebanon's economy will contract by 6.4 percent.

stories.headline: Japan’s FX Chief Warns Not To Forget Summer Intervention
stories.text: Japan's currency chief warned that it is too soon to forget the events of this summer after the yen weakened sharply. Japan's currency chief signaled that authorities stand ready to intervene again to support the Asian currency.

stories.headline: Yen Hovers Near Key 160 Level, Fueling Intervention Concerns
stories.text: The yen is trading close to the key 160-per-dollar threshold. The proximity to the 160 level creates renewed pressure on policymakers in Tokyo to intervene and support the currency.

stories.headline: Lenders in Europe and Latin America Report Results as a Fed Governor Leans Toward a Hike
stories.text: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher J. Waller stated he leans toward supporting a 25 basis point policy rate increase at the December meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee. Credicorp Ltd. reported third-quarter net income attributable to the company reached S/1,929.4 million, up 11.0% year over year.

stories.headline: Inflation jitters throw a wrench into US Treasury auction as Fed official flags jumbo hike
stories.text: The recent auction of the 10-year US Treasury experienced weak investor demand following an inflationary reading and potential aggressive rate hikes. The batch of the US$42 billion Treasury was sold at a yield of 5.02 per cent.

stories.headline: Ikea announces AI powered home furnishing pilot with German real estate platform ImmoScout24
stories.text: Ikea has launched an artificial intelligence pilot in Germany in partnership with the real estate platform ImmoScout24. The technology analyses property images and generates realistic visualisations containing Ikea furniture and home accessories. The pilot currently focuses on living rooms and bedrooms, with potential for future room expansion. Parag Parekh, Global Chief Digital Officer at Ikea Retail (Ingka Group), stated that the pilot explores digital technologies for more convenient home furnishing. Ikea plans to evaluate opportunities based on the results of the one-year pilot.

stories.headline: What to Know About Nvidia’s Investigation of CEO Jensen Huang
stories.text: Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang stated on Sunday that he had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman identified by United States intelligence agencies as a Beijing spy. The New York Times reported on Wednesday that Jensen Huang had an extramarital relationship with Nvidia vice president of health care Kimberly Powell. The Nvidia board of directors met on Wednesday to discuss the future of Jensen Huang at the company. Nvidia shares declined by more than 8 percent in after-hours trading on Wednesday following the reports. The Nvidia stock has dropped by about a third from its early October peak, resulting in a market value loss exceeding $1.5 trillion.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang Said to Have Had Relationship With Nvidia Executive Who Reports to Him
stories.text: Nvidia chief executive officer Jensen Huang had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, a subordinate executive at Nvidia. Kimberly Powell holds the position of Nvidia vice president of health care. Jensen Huang, aged 63, and Kimberly Powell, aged 48, were seen being affectionate on video at a San Jose, California hotel in March. Jensen Huang and Kimberly Powell are both married to other individuals. The board of Nvidia initiated an investigation led by the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz following Jensen Huang acknowledging an affair.

stories.headline: Arista Networks Stock Is AI Networking Demand Still Driving Strong Earnings
stories.text: Arista Networks reported strong third quarter results, though a significant portion stemmed from earlier deferred revenue reaching customer acceptance rather than solely fresh contracts. Arista Networks guided fourth quarter sales to be between US$3.9b and US$4.0b. DanielOliveira anchored the fair value of Arista Networks at US$169.91 to match the last close. Optimistic analysts previously estimated Arista Networks revenue would reach about US$30.4b by 2029. Optimistic analysts previously estimated Arista Networks earnings would reach roughly US$11.6b by 2029.

stories.headline: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
stories.text: United Airlines cited concerns regarding privacy, security, and regulatory compliance as reasons for the restriction. United Airlines is concerned that artificial intelligence agents might bypass federal regulations requiring customers to attest that their bags do not contain explosives. While artificial intelligence agents can display United Airlines flights to users, they are barred from completing transactions. United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby stated at an event on Tuesday that he does not want to create another middleman. United Airlines indicated that it might reconsider its decision in the future depending on advancements in third-party artificial intelligence agents.

stories.headline: Silicon Valley is 'a center for espionage,' former FBI agent warns after Nvidia spy scandal
stories.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to and apologized for an affair on Sunday. The Nvidia board of directors announced an independent investigation into the matter on Sunday. The Nvidia board stated at the time of the announcement that it had no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised. Concentric Advisors program manager and former FBI special agent Mark Trott stated that Silicon Valley is a center for espionage. China denied the spy plot allegations targeting Jensen Huang and called them a smear.

stories.headline: Who pays as U.S. data center boom puts pressure on the power grid?
stories.text: Arizona Public Service recorded a peak power demand of 9,164 megawatts at 6 p.m. on Aug. 2, 2026. The peak power demand on Aug. 2, 2026, was 6% higher than the previous record of 8,648 megawatts set on Aug. 7, 2025. Arizona Public Service serves approximately 1.5 million homes and businesses. Greg Bernosky stated that data centers accounted for 7% of Arizona Public Service peak demand last summer. Two proposed data center projects in Buckeye and Hassayampa Ranch could draw up to 3,300 megawatts combined.

stories.headline: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
stories.text: Google launched an experimental artificial intelligence tool called Tabletop to create customizable collaborative spaces for personal planning. Tabletop includes an artificial intelligence feature that enables users to generate personalized interactive tools by describing them. Google Labs design and engineering lead Roman Nurik stated that users can add links, files, and ideas and prompt the system to generate custom itineraries and expense splitters. Users can share an invite link in a group chat so that multiple people can access the space simultaneously. Access to the Tabletop beta is currently available through a waitlist and restricted to individuals over the age of 18 residing in the United States.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind just mathematically verified key parts of Signal
stories.text: Google DeepMind researchers used agentic AI to mathematically prove key cryptographic guarantees of the Signal protocol. The Google DeepMind proof-of-concept project was conducted in just four weeks. Google DeepMind demonstrated formal verification capabilities using a new artificial intelligence framework called AlphaProof Code. Google DeepMind researchers are releasing the specification and proof developed for the Signal protocol analysis. Google declined to share the cost of the analysis because Google DeepMind conducted the Signal analysis free of charge.

stories.headline: Oil India Declares Interim Dividend of ₹7 Per Share for Shareholders
stories.text: Oil India declared an interim dividend of ₹7 per equity share for its shareholders. In FY26, Oil India achieved daily crude oil production rates reaching 10,566 MT. Oil India reported a consolidated annual net profit of ₹7,551 crore in FY26.

stories.headline: Drone Startup Uforce Valued at $6 Billion With UK Wealth Fund Backing
stories.text: The UK National Wealth Fund made its largest defense investment in Uforce. Uforce secured funding as part of a $700 million financing round. Uforce was initially formed in Ukraine.

stories.headline: AI Helps UK Economy Post Strongest Growth Since Early 2024
stories.text: The economy of the UK achieved its fastest growth rate in two and a half years. The rollout of artificial intelligence drove increased spending by businesses. Consumers in the UK continued to cope with the energy shock resulting from the Iran war.

stories.headline: India’s retail sugar prices remain elevated despite fourfold jump in early-season production
stories.text: India's all-India average retail sugar price reached Rs 60.53 per kg as of November 11, 2026, marking a nearly 30% increase from the previous year according to the Department of Consumer Affairs. India produced 1.285 million tonnes of sugar as of November 5, which is nearly four times the output from the same period last year according to the Indian Sugar and Bio-Energy Manufacturers Association. A total of 184 sugar mills commenced crushing operations across India as of November 5, up from 154 mills during the same period last year.

stories.headline: Sensex falls 500 pts from day's high, Nifty below 25,250: Key reasons behind markets turning red
stories.text: On November 12, the Nifty ended 44.3 points or 0.18% at 25,299.35. Life Insurance Council data showed life insurance companies' first-year premium income rose 26.2% on year to Rs 42,914 crore in October. Hitesh Tailor, technical research analyst at Choice Broking, noted that rejection from higher levels indicates near-term profit booking despite the positive close.

stories.headline: Intesa Sanpaolo Balances Record Earnings Against ECB Caution on MPS Takeover
stories.text: Intesa Sanpaolo published the offer document and EU follow-on prospectus for acquiring all shares in Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena in a transaction valued at EUR 34.5 billion, with Consob approving it on Monday. The acceptance period for the Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena takeover is scheduled to run from 24 November 2026 to 22 January 2027. The European Central Bank urged caution on dividends and called for adequate capital buffers when clearing the Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena acquisition, citing transaction complexity and implementation risks.

stories.headline: We Think That There Are Issues Underlying HP Telecom India's (NSE:HPTL) Earnings
stories.text: HP Telecom India Limited's recent earnings report failed to move the market for its stock due to concerning underlying factors identified by an analysis. For the year leading up to September 2026, HP Telecom India recorded an accrual ratio of 0.85. HP Telecom India reported a profit of ₹439.5m for the year leading up to September 2026.

stories.headline: Treasury Bills: Full Auction Result
stories.text: The notified amount for the 91-Day Treasury Bills auction was ₹8,000 crore. The notified amount for the 182-Day Treasury Bills auction was ₹8,000 crore. The notified amount for the 364-Day Treasury Bills auction was ₹7,000 crore.

stories.headline: Turkey Raises Inflation Forecasts on War, Fund-Rout Effects
stories.text: Turkey's central bank increased its inflation forecasts through the end of the following year.

stories.headline: Alphabet Kicks Off Asia Bond Sale as AI Firms Face Scrutiny
stories.text: Alphabet Inc. is marketing its inaugural bond sale denominated in Hong Kong and Singapore dollars.

stories.headline: The Fed’s Other Big Debate: When Should John Williams’ Term End?
stories.text: Discussions are occurring within the US central bank regarding the rules for term limits of regional Federal Reserve leaders, triggered by the looming retirement of the Federal Reserve's longest-serving policymaker, according to people familiar with the discussions.

stories.headline: Fed chair needs friends in Congress as inflation fight drags on
stories.text: Kevin Warsh will soon face Democratic critic Senator Elizabeth Warren who will chair the Banking Committee in the next Congress.

stories.headline: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
stories.text: British artificial intelligence chip startup Fractile raised a $720 million Series C funding round backed by Britain’s Sovereign AI Fund. The British government stated that the valuation of Fractile was over £5 billion, while the Financial Times and a Reuters source reported a $7 billion figure. The latest funding round for Fractile was led by Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Redpoint. Fractile combines its hardware design with a machine learning compiler to maximize the execution speed of large language models.

stories.headline: Big Walk used AI to fix a bug. Now the indie gaming world is having a reckoning.
stories.text: Big Walk developer House House publicly disclosed that large language models were used minimally near the end of the puzzle exploration game's development. House House stated the AI assistance represented well under 0.1% of Big Walk's code and was used to help resolve a Unity engine bug causing infinite length shadows. Nineteen members of the Independent Games Festival Awards jury released a statement declining to vote for any game using generative AI in any capacity. Following the AI disclosure, the Steam page for Big Walk received over 400 negative reviews from disappointed fans and industry observers.

stories.headline: Trump Officials Clashed Over Megaspeed, Firm at Heart of Nvidia Affair
stories.text: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confronted Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick at the White House on Thursday regarding the Singaporean company Megaspeed. Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang acknowledged having an affair with Alice Huang, a woman who helped lead Megaspeed. U.S. intelligence identified Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, as a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security. A Commerce Department spokeswoman denied that the conversation between Scott Bessent and Howard Lutnick had taken place.

stories.headline: Alibaba announces plans to list T-Head, its Nvidia chip rival
stories.text: Alibaba announced late Tuesday that the Hong Kong Stock Exchange will permit the spin-off of its semiconductor subsidiary T-Head through a public offering. Hong Kong-listed shares of Alibaba traded 1% lower on Wednesday morning and are down about 29% year-to-date. In late September, Alibaba announced its next-generation AI chip, the Zhenwu V900. Short seller Culper Research alleged in May that Alibaba obtained restricted Nvidia chips by indirectly financing entities in Southeast Asia.

stories.headline: Maga architects blame Big Tech and AI data centres for midterms rout
stories.text: The head of the Heritage Foundation stated that the Republican Party's embrace of Silicon Valley cost them votes in the midterms. The head of the Heritage Foundation stated that the effect of Donald Trump's Iran war cost them votes.

stories.headline: China warns US not to use Nvidia scandal as pretext for tech curbs
stories.text: Beijing accused the United States of fabricating espionage narratives regarding Nvidia Nvidia's board is considering the future of chief executive Jensen Huang

stories.headline: Q2 Results Today Live: HAL & Oil India Q2 profit rise, Page Industries marginally flat, Alkem Lab & BDL profit decline, Vi, Hitachi, NMDC, IRCTC, Manappuram Finance, Ola Electric to announce Q2 results
stories.text: Oil India reported a 53% growth in consolidated PAT at ₹ 2,521 crore in Q2 FY27 compared to ₹ 1,644 crore in Q2 FY26. Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care reported a 6.6% profit dip to Rs 195.84 crore in Q2FY27 against Rs 209.86 crore in Q2FY26.

stories.headline: Burberry defies luxury downturn as trench coats and scarves power revival
stories.text: Burberry sales are continuing to rise in China and the US Burberry is benefiting from a strategy of refocusing on core products like trench coats and scarves

stories.headline: China’s Zhuanzhuan Is Said to Have Filed for $500 Million HK IPO
stories.text: Beijing Zhuanzhuan Spirit Technology Co. has confidentially filed for an initial public offering in Hong Kong. The initial public offering for Beijing Zhuanzhuan Spirit Technology Co. may occur as soon as next year.

stories.headline: Xi Jinping says Taiwan ‘reunification’ with China must happen
stories.text: Chinese President Xi Jinping stated that the reunification of Taiwan with China must happen and will be realized. Xi Jinping made his remarks while speaking in Beijing's Great Hall of People.

stories.headline: China Says US Should Not Use Huang Scandal to Justify Tech Curbs
stories.text: Beijing stated the United States should cease utilizing allegations regarding Chinese spying on Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang as a justification for technology restrictions. Beijing mentioned that it was in contact with American counterparts ahead of a scheduled meeting between the leaders of the two countries.

stories.headline: Malaysia seeks Taiwan meeting restart as Anwar defends China stance
stories.text: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim stated on Thursday that Malaysia will maintain trade and business cooperation with Taiwan without compromising its One China policy. Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim aims to restart bilateral investment negotiations with Taiwan that were previously suspended following remarks made about the island in August.

stories.headline: Air India to convert passenger aircraft into freighters for revenue growth
stories.text: Air India plans to convert passenger aircraft into dedicated freighters to expand its cargo business and increase revenue, as stated in a Singapore Airlines investor presentation. Air India is targeting increased sales from overseas markets and establishing a third hub in Bengaluru to mitigate the impact of rupee depreciation and Pakistan airspace closure.

stories.headline: Rohit Shrivastava Says Nifty Can Hit 35,000 Mark: Next Levels And Portfolio Call
stories.text: Analyst Rohit Shrivastava stated that the Nifty can reach 35,000 over the next 18 months. Rohit Shrivastava previously predicted the market rebound that occurred in October.

stories.headline: Russian diesel exports double after Trump lifts sanctions, but US gets none
stories.text: The boost in shipments of Russian diesel is expected to be shortlived. The increase in Russian diesel shipments is expected to be shortlived because Ukraine resumed attacks on refineries.

stories.headline: 5G fixed wireless gives rural India a rare connectivity lead
stories.text: At the end of September 2026, India recorded 13.61 million 5G fixed wireless access subscribers, featuring 7.06 million in rural areas and 6.54 million in urban areas. stories.headline: European survey reveals 900m galaxies – and possibly secrets of ‘dark universe’
stories.text: The European Space Agency launched the Euclid mission in July 2023 to map a third of the sky and create a 3D map of the universe. The Euclid mission's first major data release captures over 900 million galaxies and more than 60 million potential quasars. The newly released data covers approximately 14 percent of the total sky area scheduled to be mapped by the Euclid mission. Dark energy and dark matter are estimated to comprise about 70 percent and 25 percent of the universe respectively. The Euclid data includes about 15,000 probable cases of strong gravitational lensing, compared to about 1,000 previously known cases. Andy Taylor stated that a further release of data is expected to land next summer.
